name: axlAddAutoAssignNetAlgorithm
summary: This function allows the user to add custom auto net assignment algorithms to the list in the Logic -> Auto Assign Net command's algorithms list in the APD and SIP IC Packaging tools. This list will always contain the Cadence standard algorithms (Router-Based, Nearest Match, and Constraint-Driven).

name: axlAddSelectAll
summary: Finds all the figures in the database that pass the current Find Filter and adds their`dbids` to the select set.

name: axlAddSelectBox
summary: Finds one or more figures inside the rectangle`l_bBox` according to the current Find Filter, and adds the selected figure `dbids` in cumulated mode for the select set.

name: axlAddSelectName
summary: Adds the named figure`dbids` to the select set in cumulated mode according to the arguments described below. Adds the found figures to the select set if not already there. Selects figures completely regardless of the selection mode. If the function selects a figure already partially selected, the figure becomes fully selected.

name: axlAddSelectObject
summary: Adds the`dbids` in `lo_dbid` to the select set in cumulated mode, that is, without removing already selected objects. `lo_dbid` is either a single `dbid` or a list of `dbids`. Adds `dbids` in the select set only if they are not already there. Selects figures completely regardless of the selection mode. If the `dbid` of any part of a figure is in `lo_dbid`, adds the entire figure.

name: axlAddSelectPoint
summary: Finds a figure at`l_point` according to the Find Filter and adds its `dbid` to the select set in cumulated mode. If `l_point` is `nil`, requests a single pick from the user.

name: axlAddSimpleMoveDynamics
summary: Loads cursor buffer dynamics buffer with an element. If dynamics buffer is already loaded, the new element is simply added to the existing buffer. Dynamics buffer is not cleared untilaxlClearDynamics is called.

name: axlAddSimpleRbandDynamics
summary: Loads rubber band dynamics buffer with an element. If dynamics buffer is already loaded, the new element is simply added to the existing buffer. Dynamics buffer is not cleared untilaxlClearDynamics is called.

name: axlAddTaper
summary: Adds tapered trace. Tapered trace parameters are controlled from the Glossing "Pad and T" Parameter form.

name: axlAirGap
summary: Finds the air gap and location between two given items. Gap is the same as reported by the`show measure` command. Any geometric objects; logical, group or symbols not supported (same as show measure). Unfilled shapes are currently treated as filled but this may change in the future.

name: axlAltSymbolList
summary: This queries the provided object and returns a list of alternative symbol names.

name: axlAltSymbolOK
summary: This verifies that symbol is legal for component. Must be in the ALT_SYMBOL list with the correct layer.

name: axlAltSymbolReplace
summary: This replaces a PLACED component with one of its allowed replacements (ALT_SYMBOL). To be successful the following must be true

name: axlAutoOpenFindFilter
summary: This function is no longer required, but is kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlBackDrill
summary: This interface is obsolete. UseaxlBackdrillGet to retrieve actual backdrilling of pins and vias. Data returned by this interface may not match the actual backdrill results in the design.

name: axlBackdrillGet
summary: In one mode, when a pin or a via is provided, the command returns the backdrilling result on that pin or via.

name: axlBondFingerDelete
summary: Deletes the (list of) bond fingers passed in. Optionally, it will delete the connect bond wire elements as well.

name: axlBuildClassPopup
summary: Supports building a form pop-up with a list of classes.

name: axlBuildSubclassPopup
summary: Supports building a form pop-up with a list of subclasses from the indicated class.

name: axlCNSAssemblyModeGet
summary: This retrieves the current assembly DRC mode(s). Modes determine if a particular constraint is on or off. These DRC modes apply to the entire design. Use`axlCNSAssemblyModeGet(nil)` to determine the set currently supported assembly modes.The `'print` mode offers the name shown in reports like show element.

name: axlCNSAssemblyModeSet
summary: This command sets the current DRC modes (on/off) for checks in the area of assembly constraints. These modes are global.

name: axlCNSCreate
summary: Creates a new constraint set in the specified domain. For spacing and physical csets, you must supply an existing cset as the copy cset. If the`copyName` is nil, the DEFAULT cset is used. Electrical csets (ECsets) are created empty for a nil `copyName` . By default, the ECset created is empty. If you provide a second argument, the ECset contents are copied.

name: axlCNSCsetLock
summary: This locks or unlocks a constraint set in the given domain. See discussion inaxlCNSIsLockedDomain.

name: axlCNSDelete
summary: Deletes a cset and its references to any objects such as nets, net classes, etc. Locked csets must first be unlocked before you delete them. If it is a spacing or physical domain, you cannot delete the DEFAULT cset. You cannot delete electrical csets in Allegro PCB Design L.

name: axlCNSDesignModeGet
summary: Gets the current DRC modes for checks that fall into the set of design constraints. These constraints pertain to the entire board. To determine the design constraint checks currently supported, use the`axlCNSDesignModeGet()` command.

name: axlCNSDesignModeSet
summary: Sets the current DRC modes for design constraints. The modes control the DRC for that design constraint check on the entire board.

name: axlCNSDesignValueCheck
summary: Checks the syntax of the given value against the allowed syntax for the given constraint. You use the function`axlCNSDesignGetValue(nil)` to get the constraint names.

name: axlCNSDesignValueGet
summary: Fetches the values from those design constraints that support values. Use`axlCNSDesignValueGet(nil)` to determine the set of these constraints.

name: axlCNSDesignValueSet
summary: This sets the value of the design constraint.

name: axlCNSEcsetCreate
summary: Creates a new ECset. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets. The name must be legal and less than the maximum length allowed. Function fails if the ECset already exists.

name: axlCNSEcsetDelete
summary: Deletes an ECset from the Allegro PCB Editor database and also deletes the`ELECTRICAL_CONSTRAINT_SET` property from any nets assigned this ECset value. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetGet
summary: Returns the`dbid` of the electrical cset when you request it by the ECset name. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for grouping a set of electrical constraints and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetModeGet
summary: Returns the current DRC modes for checks that are members of electrical constraints. These modes pertain to the entire board. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetModeSet
summary: Sets the DRC modes for checks that are members of the electrical constraints set. These modes control the entire board. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetValueCheck
summary: Checks the syntax of the given value against the allowed syntax for the given constraint. You use the function`axlCNSEcseValueGet (nil)` to get the constraint names. Electrical Constraint Set (ECSet) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetValueGet
summary: Fetches the constraint values for a given ECset. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSEcsetValueSet
summary: Sets the value of the ECset DRC. Electrical Constraint Set (ECset) is a mechanism for packaging up a set of electrical constraints into a group and applying them to a set of nets.

name: axlCNSGetAssembly
summary: Obtains an Assembly cset values. In the first operational mode, the command obtains the value of an assembly constraint given a cset and a layer. In second mode of operation, it obtains all assembly constraint as name-value pairs for a cset on a layer. For the last mode, a list of all supported assembly constraints is obtained by passing three`nil` values to the interface:`axlCNSGetAssembly(nil nil nil)`

name: axlCNSGetDefaultMinLineWidth
summary: Retrieves the minimum default line width value for the specific subclass.

name: axlCNSGetPhysical
summary: In its first operational mode, obtains the value of a physical constraint given a cset and layer. In the second mode of operation, it obtains all physical constraint as name/value pairs for a cset on a layer. This, in turn, may be passed to`axlCNSSetPhysical`.

name: axlCNSGetPinDelayEnabled
summary: Returns if pin delay is enabled.

name: axlCNSGetPinDelayPVF
summary: Returns the pin delay propagation velocity factor.

name: axlCNSGetSameNet
summary: Documentation same asaxlCNSGetSpacing.

name: axlCNSGetSameNetXtalkEnabled
summary: Returns if Same Net Xtalk is enabled.

name: axlCNSGetSpacing
summary: In its first operational mode, obtains the value of a spacing constraint given a cset and layer. All values are returned in design units, except for`same_net,` which is a boolean (`t/nil`). In a second mode of operation, it obtains all spacing constraints as name/value pairs for a cset on a layer. This, in turn, may be passed to `axlCNSSetSpacing`. For the final mode, a list of supported spacing constraints may be obtained by passing three `nil` values to this interface:

name: axlCNSGetViaZEnabled
summary: Returns if Via Z is enabled.

name: axlCNSGetViaZPVF
summary: Returns the via Z propagation velocity factor

name: axlCNSIsCsetLocked
summary: This returns if a cset is locked. See discussion inaxlCNSIsLockedDomain.

name: axlCNSIsLockedDomain
summary: Used to check if the is constraint domain locked. A locked constraint domain has the following characteristics:

name: axlCNSLockDomain
summary: This command locks or unlocks a constraint domain.

name: axlCNSMapClear
summary: See`axlCNSMapUpdate`.

name: axlCNSMapUpdate
summary: This function and`axlCNSMapClear`, which do not support nesting, batch and tune DRC updates from constraint changes made by `axlCNS<``xxx``>` functions. No `axlCNS<``xxx``>` functions perform a DRC update. Rather, they set the DRC system out-of-date.

name: axlCNSPhysicalModeGet
summary: This fetches the current physical drc mode(s). Modes determine if a particular constraint is on or off. These modes apply to the entire board. To determine the set currently supported, physical modes do a`axlCNSPhysicalModeGet`(nil). The physical mode set may be a subset of physical values since the implementation may associate certain values under a master mode. For example, via_list is not a constraint and the diff pair mode is under the ecset domain.

name: axlCNSPhysicalModeSet
summary: This sets the current drc modes (on/off) for checks in the area of physical constraints. These modes are global. To determine the constraints modes currently supported do a`axlCNSPhysicalModeGet(nil)`. We support several interfaces. All checks may be set (`'all`), individual checks, (`t_name`), list of checks with a same mode`'(s_name ...) t_mode/s_mode'(t_name ...) t_mode/s_mode` and sets of checks via a list of: `'((s_name/t_name s_mode/t_mode) ....)`

name: axlCNSSameNetModeGet
summary: Same asaxlCNSSpacingModeGet.

name: axlCNSSameNetModeSet
summary: Same as axlCNSSpacingModeSet.

name: axlCNSSetAssembly
summary: Updates assembly cset, wire profile or symbol constraint values. By passing`nil` at the appropriate argument, values for all csets and all layers may be changed.

name: axlCNSSetPhysical
summary: Allows updating physical constraint values. By passing nil at the appropriate argument, values for all csets and all layers may be changed.

name: axlCNSSetPinDelayEnabled
summary: Enables or disables Pin Delay.

name: axlCNSSetPinDelayPVF
summary: Sets a value for pin delay propagation velocity.

name: axlCNSSetSameNet
summary: Documentation same asaxlCNSSetSpacing.

name: axlCNSSetSameNetXtalkEnabled
summary: Enables or disables Same Net Xtalk.

name: axlCNSSetSpacing
summary: Allows updating spacing constraint values. By passing`nil`at the appropriate argument, values for all csets and all layers may be changed.

name: axlCNSSetViaZEnabled
summary: Enables or disables Via Z.

name: axlCNSSetViaZPVF
summary: Sets a value for Via Z propagation velocity factor.

name: axlCNSSpacingMax
summary: Returns maximum spacing in design. This can be worst case spacing of entire design or base upon the object filtering.

name: axlCNSSpacingMin
summary: Returns minimum spacing value in the design. This can be the minimum spacing of entire design or based upon the object filtering.

name: axlCNSSpacingModeGet
summary: This fetches the current spacing drc mode(s). Modes determine if a particular constraint is on or off. These modes apply to the entire board. To determine the set currently supported spacing modes do a axlCNSSpacingModeGet(nil).

name: axlCNSSpacingModeSet
summary: This sets the current drc modes (on/off) for checks in the area of spacing constraints. These modes are global. To determine the constraints modes currently supported do a`axlCNSSpacingModeGet`(nil). We support several interfaces. All checks may be set ('all), individual checks, (t_name), list of checks with a same mode '(s_name ...) t_mode/s_mode '(t_name ...) t_mode/s_mode and sets of checks via a list of: '((s_name/t_name s_mode/t_mode) ....) The constraints names may be passed as a symbol or a string. For performance reasons, you should either do all your updates in a single call or wrap individual changes in the map API (see axlCNSMapUpdate).

name: axlCVFColorChooserDlg
summary: Displays color palette modal dialog. Color wells reflect current design colors.

name: axlCancelEnterFun
summary: Terminates the wait for a user-selected point. Waiting function returns no data.

name: axlCancelOn
summary: Allows Skill code to test for when a user clicks*Cancel*.

name: axlChangeLayer
summary: Changes layer for lines, clines or segments, shapes, and text. Functionality offered, at the global level, matches the Allegro PCB Editor`change` command, but can differ in certain areas.

name: axlChangeLine2Cline
summary: Changes provided lines to clines. Lines not on an etch layer are ignored. If a line is converted to a cline then it may be assigned to a net, otherwise it will be left on a the standalone branch.

name: axlChangeLineFont
summary: Changes font on a line or segment.

name: axlChangeNet
summary: Changes the net an object is currently on. Restricted to shapes, filled rectangles (frectangles), pins and vias. Returns`t` when successful. Will not rip up clines or vias.

name: axlChangeWidth
summary: Changes width of lines, clines and segments (arc and line).

name: axlCheckString
summary: Checks the provided string for legal characters and length. You must also provide the data type. Give this API two nils if you want to see the list of supported data types.

name: axlClasses
summary: Return list of classes.The is actually just:

name: axlClearDynamics
summary: Clears the dynamic cursor buffer. Call this function each time before you start setting up rubberband and dynamic cursor graphics.

name: axlClearObjectCustomColor
summary: Clear custom color of dbids

name: axlClearSelSet
summary: Removes all`dbids` from select set.

name: axlClipboardGetText
summary: This gets the current text in the system clipboard. Clipboard can contain data other than ASCII text in which case`nil` is returned.

name: axlClipboardSetText
summary: Sends indicated text to system clipboard. Only ASCII text is supported.

name: axlCloseFindFilter
summary: This function is no longer required, but is kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlCmdList
summary: Lists commands registered by`axlCmdRegister`. The list consists of paired strings.

name: axlCmdRegister
summary: Registers a command named`t_allegroCmd` with the Allegro PCB Editor shell system. If the command already exists, either because it is a base Allegro PCB Editor command or because it has been registered by this function at an earlier time, it will be hidden.

name: axlCmdUnregister
summary: Unregisters or removes from the Allegro PCB Editor shell system, a previously registered command named`t_allegroCmd`. If the command already exists because it is a base Allegro PCB Editor command, the original command is available again.

name: axlCnsAddVia
summary: Adds padstack to the constraint via list of a physical cset. Via is added to end of list (seeaxlCnsGetViaList of via ordering functionality in etch editing).

name: axlCnsAssignPurge
summary: Obsolete. Kept for backward compatibility

name: axlCnsClassTableChange
summary: This command changes the Csets associated with an existing net class table entry.

name: axlCnsClassTableCreate
summary: This command creates a class table entry that consists of any of the following:

name: axlCnsClassTableDelete
summary: Deletes one or more entries in the class table.

name: axlCnsClassTableFind
summary: This command searches the class table for class table entries matching the search criteria.

name: axlCnsClassTableSeek
summary: This command seeks a specific class table entry matching exactly the provided`dbids`. Order of class1 and class2 does not matter since C1/C2 is the same as C2/C1 and only one entry exists in the table.

name: axlCnsDeleteClassClassObjects
summary: Delete all Class-Class entries.

name: axlCnsDeleteRegionClassClassObjects
summary: Deletes all Region-Class-Class entries.

name: axlCnsDeleteRegionClassObjects
summary: Delete all Region-Class entries.

name: axlCnsDeleteVia
summary: Deletes padstack from the physical via constraint list,`t_csetName`. If `t_csetName` is `nil`, delete provided padstack from all physical constraint sets.

name: axlCnsGetViaList
summary: Returns padstacks defined in a physical constraint set. If the cset name is provided then returns only vias assigned for that cset. Otherwise the function returns vias for all csets. The same vias may appear more than once when using the`nil` option.

name: axlCnsList
summary: Returns the list of cset names of the domain specified. See`axlDBGetDesign()->ecsets` for a list of electrical csets.

name: axlCnsNetFlattened
summary: Permits a view of constraints where explicit pinpair rules are promoted to the net. The information reported by the function is the same as in`show element` under the Properties attached to net heading. It is also in a format used by the third party netlist (`netin`) and in the `pstxnet.dat` file used by `netrev`.

name: axlCnsPurgeAll
summary: Removes all unused constraint objects and constraint sets. Process all netclasses, regions, physical constraint sets and spacing constraint sets. Deletes all empty netclasses and regions.

name: axlCnsPurgeCsets
summary: Process all constraint sets of the specified domain and delete those without references.

name: axlCnsPurgeObjects
summary: Process the database and delete all group_type objects that have no members; a netclass with no nets, or a region with no shapes.

name: axlColorDoc
summary: Allegro supports two color access methods: pre-defined colors and Allegro database colors. Not all Allegro based programs support access to Allegro database colors. (This is only supported by the graphics editors.)

name: axlColorGet
summary: Get color palette. Supports the following modes:

name: axlColorLoad
summary: Loads an Allegro PCB Editor color file (default .`col` file). Master color file is located at `<cdsroot>/share/pcb/text/lallegro.col`.

name: axlColorOnGet
summary: This function is obsolete. Due to change in display model, switching off colors is no longer supported.

name: axlColorOnSet
summary: This is an obsolete command. Due to changes in the viewing model, now you cannot turn off a color in Allegro PCB Editor.

name: axlColorPriorityGet
summary: Due to the changes in color model of Allegro PCB Editor, this command is now obsolete. Instead of this command, useaxlLayerPriorityGet.

name: axlColorPrioritySet
summary: Due to the changes in color model of Allegro PCB Editor, this command is now obsolete. Instead of this command, useaxlLayerPrioritySet.

name: axlColorSave
summary: Saves current design colors to specified file.

name: axlColorSet
summary: Sets red, green, blue palette for a color number or background.

name: axlColorShadowGet
summary: Provides the options of shadow mode.

name: axlColorShadowSet
summary: Sets the shadow mode options. These are equivalent to the color commands in the shadow mode box under the Display group.

name: axlCompAddPin
summary: This function adds one or more pins to the specified component. Pins are added to the corresponding component and symbol definition, with changes being reflected in all instances of those definitions.

name: axlCompDeletePin
summary: This function deletes the specified pin(s) from the parent component and symbol definition. As a result, the pin will also be deleted from all instances of these definitions and not just the instance the pin passed in belongs to.

name: axlCompMovePin
summary: This function moves the specified pin(s) by the specified delta x/y, rotation, and mirror. Rotation and mirror, if provided, are applied around the`rotatePoint` (defaults to 0,0 if not provided). A rotation to apply to each individual pin may also be provided.

name: axlCompSetPinAttributes
summary: This function modifies attributes of the specified pin(s) at the symbol and component definition level. Things like the padstack, pin number, and swap code (see below for full list of supported attributes). All update items, if not set, will be left at the pin's existing value.

name: axlCompileSymbol
summary: Compiles and edit checks the current (symbol) design and saves the compiled version on disk under the name`t_name`. If `t_name` is not provided, then `t_name` is the current drawing name. If `t_name` is provided as `nil`, you are prompted for the name. Uses the symbol type in determining some of the edit checks.

name: axlComponentChangeClass
summary: This command changes the component class of a component definition.

name: axlConductorBottomLayer
summary: Returns the name of the bottom conductor layer.

name: axlConductorTopLayer
summary: Returns the name of the top conductor layer.

name: axlControlRaise
summary: Raises a tab in the control panel to the top. If you use this at the start of an interactive command, you override the environment variable,`control_auto_raise`.

name: axlCopyObject
summary: Use this function to copy the database object(s). This supports the same functionality asaxlTransformObject except it copies and transforms one or more objects.

name: axlCopyProperties
summary: This copies properties from one object to another. It filters certain properties. If you need to copy properties suggest you utilize this interface instead doing it yourself.

name: axlCreateAttachment
summary: Creates a new Allegro PCB Editor database attachment with the given attachment id. The attachment may optionally be given a password and a revision number. The attachment data may be specified as a string or as a file name.

name: axlCreateBondFinger
summary: This function adds a valid, fully-instantiated bond finger to the database. Bond fingers created through this interface can be safely manipulated by the wirebond toolset and will also be properly recognized by all aspects of the database (DRC, signal integrity, 3D viewer, and so on).

name: axlCreateBondWire
summary: This function adds a valid, fully-instantiated bond wire to the database. Bond wires created through this interface can be safely manipulated by the wirebond toolset and will also be properly recognized by all aspects of the database (DRC, signal integrity, 3D viewer, etc).

name: axlCreateDeviceFileTemplate
summary: This creates a template device file providing same functionality as the create device command in the symbol editor. Normally you would useaxlDBCreateComponent to create a device file if in the board.

name: axlCreateWirebondGuide
summary: This function adds a wirebond guide path into the design, which can then be used to snap fingers through the wirebond tools.

name: axlCurrentDesign
summary: Returns the name of the currently active layout. This is the drawing name in the main window's title bar.

name: axlCursorGet
summary: This command is used to obtain the current cursor position either in pixels (screen units) or converted into current design units. The mapping from pixels to design units takes into account the current window view and zoom factor of the design.

name: axlCursorWarp
summary: Use this command to set the cursor position. May set the cursor either by pixel or design units. If setting by design units the new value must be within the current viewable window (axlWindowBoxGet).

name: axlCustomColorObject
summary: Custom color the provided dbid or list of dbids. Objects supported are nets, symbol instances, pins, and external DRCs.

name: axlDB2Path
summary: This takes a database id (`od_dbId`) and converts it to an r_path. This function supports all dbids with a segment attribute. For example, shape, void, path, and line.

name: axlDBActiveShape
summary: Returns the`dbid` of the open shape, if any.

name: axlDBAddGroupObjects
summary: Adds the database objects specified in the new members list to a group. All restrictions and disclaimers specified inaxlDBCreateGroup also apply for this procedure.

name: axlDBAddProp
summary: Adds all the property/value pairs listed in`ll_name_value` to all the object `dbids` listed in `lrd_attach`. If a particular object does not accept a particular property name in `ll_name_value`, `axlDBAddProp` silently ignores that combination, and continues. If an object already has the specific property attached, `axlDBAddProp` silently replaces its original value with the one specified in `ll_name_value`.

name: axlDBAltOrigin
summary: Returns alternative center for a`dbid`. This provides Skill access to the `move` command's origin point option in the Options tab.

name: axlDBAssignNet
summary: Assigns an object or a list of objects to a new net. Supports pins, vias, and shapes. Vias may not stay on net assigned if they do not connect to an object on the new net. This is not applicable if the new net has RETAIN_NET_ON_VIAS property.

name: axlDBChangeDesignExtents
summary: Changes design extents. This may fail if an object falls outside the new extents or if the extents exceed the database range.

name: axlDBChangeDesignOrigin
summary: Changes the origin of the design. This may fail if the new design origin falls outside the maximum integer range.

name: axlDBChangeDesignUnits
summary: Changes the units and accuracy of the design. To maintain the current design value, use`nil` for `t_units` or `x_accuracy`.

name: axlDBChangeText
summary: Modifies the characteristics of a text string in the layout. To keep current settings on the text, set the arguments,`t_text` and `r_textOrientation` to `nil`. To move text use the axlTransformObject object.

name: axlDBCheck
summary: Runs*dbdoctor* on the current database. By default, no log file is produced. You can specify the `'log` option which writes the standard `dbdoctor.log` file. A port descriptor can be the second argument to write the `dbdoctor` output to an external file.

name: axlDBCloak
summary: Improves performance and program memory use while modifying many items in the database. You use`axlDBCloak` to update many etch or package symbols in batch mode. Works like SKILL's `eval` function. You pass it a function and its arguments using the following format:

name: axlDBControl
summary: Inquires and/or sets the value of a special database control. If the setting is a value, the return is the old value of the control.

name: axlDBCopyPadstack
summary: Creates a new padstack by copying an existing padstack, with optional removal of layers. The name for the new padstack automatically derives from the existing name by adding a unique post fix. The padstack is marked in the design as derived from its starting padstack.

name: axlDBCreateCircle
summary: Create a circle at indicated location and with indicated diameter.

name: axlDBCreateCloseShape
summary: Closes the current open shape and applies the fill pattern specified in`axlDBCreateOpenShape`. Then performs DRC. If the fill fails, the function returns `nil`.

name: axlDBCreateComponent
summary: Given the information needed to describe a Allegro PCB Editor device, create the Allegro PCB Editor component and return its`dbid`. If the component definition already exists, use the existing definition to create the new component. If the component definition does not exist, create a new definition using the device file and create the new component.

name: axlDBCreateConceptComponent
summary: Given the Concept information needed to describe an Allegro PCB Editor device, create the Allegro PCB Editor component and return its`dbid`. If the component definition already exists, use the existing definition to create the new component. If the component definition does not exist, create a new definition and then create the component instance. Concept information comes from a `chips_prt` file and from a physical parts table (PPT). Determine the location of this information using the `cptList``XXX` family of routines, which allow browsing through a Concept library.

name: axlDBCreateExternalDRC
summary: Creates an externally-defined (by user) DRC containing the values given in the arguments. An externally defined DRC marker always has the two characters "X D" in it.

name: axlDBCreateFilmRec
summary: This interface is obsolete. It is kept to support existing Skill code.

name: axlDBCreateGroup
summary: Creates a new group database object with members specified by`lo_groupMembers`.

name: axlDBCreateLine
summary: Create a path of fixed width straight segments, a line with series of provided points. If line is on an ETCH layer a cline will be created unless overridden with the`'line` symbol.

name: axlDBCreateManyModuleInstances
summary: Creates multiple module instances in the design. By reducing the number of times the module definition file opens, this function optimizes performance when creating several instances of the same module.

name: axlDBCreateModuleDef
summary: Creates a module based on existing database objects.

name: axlDBCreateModuleInstance
summary: Allows you to use or place a previously defined module.

name: axlDBCreateNet
summary: Creates a net in database if does not exist or returns`dbid` of net if it exists.

name: axlDBCreateOpenShape
summary: Creates a shape based on the characteristic of either`o_polygon` or`r_path`. With `r_path`, fills parameters, layer, netname, and parent you specify. Returns the `dbid` of the shape in open state. Open state means you can add and delete voids of the shape. With `o_polygon`, creates a shape with the boundary defined by the boundary of the polygon. The holes in the polygon are added as voids to the shape. (See `axlPolyFromDB`.)

name: axlDBCreatePadStack
summary: Adds a padstack`t_name`, using drill hole `r_drill` and pad definition `l_pad`.

name: axlDBCreatePath
summary: Creates a path figure (line or cline) as specified. Does not add a net name to etch when the etch is not connected to a pin, via, or shape. If etch is added, it ties to the first net it touches, otherwise it remains "not a net" as specified by the arguments described below.

name: axlDBCreatePin
summary: Adds a pin with padstack`t_padstack`, pin name `r_pinText` at location `l_anchorPoint`, and rotated by `f_rotation` degrees.

name: axlDBCreatePropDictEntry
summary: Creates an Allegro user-defined property dictionary entry with given attributes. Once a dictionary entry is created, the property can then be attached to objects.

name: axlDBCreateRectangle
summary: Creates a rectangle with coordinates specified by`l_bBox`. If the rectangle is not created, the function returns `nil`.

name: axlDBCreateShape
summary: Takes the same arguments as`axlDBCreateOpenShape` and adds the `r_path` shape to the database. The difference is that this function creates the shape and puts it into the closed state immediately, rather than leaving it open for modification. Use `axlDBCreateShape` to add shapes without voids.

name: axlDBCreateSymDefSkeleton
summary: Creates a "minimal" symbol definition. While the symbol name and type must be provided, the instance is created only with pins. Once this "skeleton" definition has been created, you add the rest of the symbol geometry with additional`axlDBCreate` calls. This provides the ability to create symbols that do not exist in the library.

name: axlDBCreateSymbol
summary: Places a symbol instance in the design. Creates a symbol instance at location`l_anchor_point` with the given mirror and rotation. Examines its first argument to determine what symbol to add, as explained later. Next, searches for the symbol in the symbol definitions, first in the layout, then in the `PSMPATH`. Loads the definition if it is not already in the layout and creates the symbol instance. Returns `nil` a symbol definition is not found.

name: axlDBCreateSymbolAutosilk
summary: Creates or updates the`AUTOSILK` information for the specified symbol, as required. Also updates, as required, any other `AUTOSILK` information near the symbol.

name: axlDBCreateSymbolSkeleton
summary: Places a skeleton or a minimal symbol instance at`l_anchorPoint` with mirror and rotation given but no data in the instance, except the pin data given by `l_pinData`. This is a list of `axlPinData` defstructs defining the data for all pins. The pin count and pin numbers must match that of the library symbol definition. The symbol definition must exist in the database or on `LIBPATH`.

name: axlDBCreateText
summary: Creates a text string in the layout using the arguments described.

name: axlDBCreateVia
summary: Creates a via in the layout as specified by the arguments described below.

name: axlDBCreateVoid
summary: Adds a void to a shape. To add multiple voids, it is recommended that you either add the voids when creating the shape (axlDBCreateShape) or re-open the shape (axlDBOpenShape) before creating the voids.

name: axlDBCreateVoidCircle
summary: Creates a circular void in the open shape`o_shape`. Calling this function without an open shape causes an error.

name: axlDBDelLock
summary: Deletes a lock on the database. If the database is locked with a password, you must supply the correct password to unlock it.

name: axlDBDeleteProp
summary: Deletes the properties listed by name, in`lt_name`, from the objects whose `dbids` are in `lo_attach`.

name: axlDBDeletePropAll
summary: Deletes all instances of the property t_name in the database. This includes properties that exist on the symDef and compDef that cannot be access via the property edit command. If you delete a property that effects the DRC system, you may wish to wrap this call with a axlDBCloak for better performance.

name: axlDBDisbandGroup
summary: Disbands the database group you specify with the`o_group` argument, thereby immediately removing the group. Members of the group are not deleted.

name: axlDBDisplayControl
summary: This command is used to inquire and set the display database controls. When used for setting a value, the command returns the old value of the control.

name: axlDBDummyNet
summary: This command returns all dummy nets in design. Two courtesy options provided are:

name: axlDBDynamicShapes
summary: Queries and updates dynamic shapes. When`g_value` is `t,` updates all out of date dynamic shapes on the board regardless of the dynamic shape updating setting in the **Drawing Options** dialog. When `g_value` is `nil`, returns a count of out of date shapes.

name: axlDBFindByName
summary: Finds`dbid` of an object by name without involving the selection set. This means you can run this command any time without affecting what exists in the selection set. The following object lookup types are supported:

name: axlDBGetAttachedText
summary: Returns the list of`dbids` of text objects attached to the object whose `dbid` is `o_dbid`. If axlDBGetDesign is used to retrieve the dbid, the function returns all text attached to root design.

name: axlDBGetConnect
summary: Finds all the elements, including pads and shapes, that are connected to a given`dbid`. Input can be a PIN, VIA, T, CLINE/CARC or CLINE/CARC SEGMENT, and shapes.

name: axlDBGetDesign
summary: Returns the root design`dbid`. Use this `dbid` to get the design properties and to add properties to the design.

name: axlDBGetDesignUnits
summary: Returns the design units and accuracy number of the active design.

name: axlDBGetDrillPlating
summary: Retrieves the plating type of the padstack passed as an argument to this function.

name: axlDBGetExtents
summary: Provides the extents of a physical database object. You choose between getting the extents of the entire object (even if it is currently not visible) or just the current visible objects.

name: axlDBGetGroupFromItem
summary: Filter object's group membership by a group type. You can normally fetch the list of groups that an object is a member of by using the groups attribute of its dbid (etc. o_dbid->groups). This function provides additional filtering where you can request if an belongs to a particular group type. Depending upon the group characteristics an object can either belong to single group of a type or can be a member multiple groups of a single type. For example, an object can belong to multiple generic groups can belong to only one differential pair group.

name: axlDBGetLayerType
summary: Retrieves the cross-section type of a given layer. This may be (Layer Type in define xsection form):`CONDUCTOR`, `DIELECTRIC`, `PLANE`, `SURFACE`, `DIESTACK` or `MASK`.

name: axlDBGetLength
summary: Calculates the length of the given object which may be a NET, CLINE, SEGMENT, or RATSNEST. If RATSNEST returns the Manhattan length. If a net is partially routed, includes sum of all ratsnest Manhattan lengths.

name: axlDBGetLock
summary: Returns information about a lock on the database. You retrieve the following information:

name: axlDBGetLonelyBranches
summary: Returns a list of the*standalone branch* `dbids` in the design. A *standalone branch* is a branch not associated with any net.

name: axlDBGetManhattan
summary: Given a net, calculates an etch, path, and Manhattan length. The result is the same as that used by list element.

name: axlDBGetPad
summary: For the pin or via specified by`o_dbid`, gets the pad of type `t_type` associated with layer `t_layer`.

name: axlDBGetPropDict
summary: Returns a list of property definitions in the current design. Several trivial filters are defined:

name: axlDBGetPropDictEntry
summary: Gets the property dictionary entry for the property name given by the string`t_name`. Use axlDBGetPropDictEntry to get the information about a property dictionary entry. If name is `nil`, the command returns a list of legal objects that can be used to create property dictionary entries. This is the `objects` attribute of the `o_propDictEntry` data type. You cannot create a property with the same name as an existing Allegro property.

name: axlDBGetProperties
summary: Gets the properties attached to a specified object. Returns the properties in an assoc list, that is, a list of lists, each of which contains a name and a value. The SKILL`assoc` function can operate using this list.

name: axlDBGetShapes
summary: Provides quick access to shapes without access to visibility or find settings.

name: axlDBGetSymbolBodyExtent
summary: This returns the body extent of a symbol. Unlike the bBox associated with a dbid, a body extents is either one of the following.

name: axlDBGetTextBlockCount
summary: Returns a count of the number of text blocks defined.

name: axlDBGridGet
summary: This command returns current grid values. Function has two modes:

name: axlDBGridSet
summary: This command modifies the grid settings in the design.

name: axlDBGroupRename
summary: Renames a group. Groups supported are GENERIC, BUS, DIFF_PAIR, NETCLASS, NET_GROUP and MATCH_GROUP. Do not attempt to rename group types not listed.

name: axlDBIgnoreFixed
summary: Provides similar functionality to that offered by many Allegro batch programs which allow FIXED and LOCKED properties to be ignored (for example:`netrev -z`).

name: axlDBIsBondingWireLayer
summary: This is an obsolete function. Bonding wire layers have been replaced by die stack layers. Use`axlDBIsDieStackLayer` to check whether a layer is a die stack layer.

name: axlDBIsBondpad
summary: Verifies whether or not the given element is a*bondpad*.

name: axlDBIsBondwire
summary: Verifies whether or not the given element is a*bonding wire*.

name: axlDBIsDiePad
summary: Verifies whether or not the given element is a*die pad*.

name: axlDBIsDieStackLayer
summary: Verifies if layer is a die stack layer. This means that the attribute of the`"paramLayer"` parameter `dbid` called `"type"` has a value of `"DIESTACK"`. This is normally used in the APD product.

name: axlDBIsFixed
summary: Verifies whether or not the specified database object is fixed. When the FIXED property is present if can either be directly on the object, on a parent (e.g. a CLINE is fixed if the NET is fixed) or on a child (e.g. a symbol is fixed if its place bounds is fixed).

name: axlDBIsPackagePin
summary: Verifies whether or not the given element is a*package pin*.

name: axlDBIsPlatingbarPin
summary: Verifies whether or not the given element is a*plating bar pin*.

name: axlDBIsReadOnly
summary: This API command checks if indicated database object is read-only.

name: axlDBMemoryReclaim
summary: Reclaims database memory for reuse by the Allegro database. Normally in Skill memory of deleted database objects is not reused until Skill code returns to the main processing loop.

name: axlDBOpenShape
summary: Opens an existing shape to replace its boundary or to modify its voids.

name: axlDBPinPairLength
summary: Calculate the shortest length between 2 pins. Pins must be on the same xnet. The pin can also be a VIA or RAT_T. If the distance is not fully routed, it includes a Manhattan estimate of the unrouted portion.

name: axlDBRefreshId
summary: Updates the attributes of the object specified by`o_dbid`. Subsequent attribute retrieval requests access the updated information.

name: axlDBRemoveGroupObjects
summary: Removes the database objects from the specified group. Group members, though removed, are not deleted.

name: axlDBSectorSize
summary: This is obsolete. It is kept for backwards compatibility. It now callsaxlDBTuneSectorSize. Tuning sectors is now built into dbdoctor.

name: axlDBSetLock
summary: Provides a mechanism to lock the database against future changes. If you lock the database it is locked in memory, to save the lock, you need to save the database to disk. Therefore, after locking the database, you can save the database once before all further attempts to save the database are rejected.

name: axlDBTextBlockCompact
summary: Reports and/or compresses unused database text blocks. If compacting text blocks, it always updates database text to reflect the new text block numbers.

name: axlDBTextBlockCreate
summary: Creates a new text block from the template block number provided. By providing optional text block characteristics, you can get available text blocks by:

name: axlDBTextBlockFindName
summary: Finds a text block based on its name.

name: axlDBTextBlockGetName
summary: Returns the name associated with the given text block. Same as attribute`userName` in `axlGetParam("paramTextBlock:<number>")`.

name: axlDBTextBlockSetName
summary: Defines a name for a given text block.

name: axlDBTransactionCommit
summary: Commits a database transaction from the last transaction mark.

name: axlDBTransactionMark
summary: Writes a mark in the database that you can use withaxlDBTransactionOops to rollback database changes to this mark.

name: axlDBTransactionOops
summary: Undoes a transaction back to the last mark, or to start if there are no marks. Supports the Allegro*oops* model for database transactions.

name: axlDBTransactionRollback
summary: Undo function for a database transaction.

name: axlDBTransactionStart
summary: Marks the start of a transaction to the database. Returns a mark to the caller which is passed back to commit, mark, oops or rollback for nested transactions. Only the outermost caller of this function (the first caller) has control to commit or rollback the entire transaction.

name: axlDBTuneSectorSize
summary: This tune's Allegro's sector size for better performance. Normally, this occurs automatically via dbdoctor or performance advisor. In addition, it is done periodically during design open.

name: axlDMBrowsePath
summary: Invokes a standard Allegro PCB Editor file browser supporting paths, for example,`SCRIPTPATH`. To use, pass one of the file types supported by `fileops.txt`. Browses file types that include the fileops `PATH` attribute. `axlDMFileBrowse` should be used to browse other file types. This works on non-PATH file types since this browses in the current working directory. The user is not able to change the directory with this browser.

name: axlDMClose
summary: Closes a file currently open in Allegro PCB Editor. Instead of using Skill's infile/outfile commands, this command must be used to close the files opened using`axlDMOpenFile` or `axlDMOpenLog` commands.

name: axlDMDirectoryBrowse
summary: Opens a directory browser. Unlike file browsers, this only allows a user to select a directory. This function call blocks until the user selects or cancels.

name: axlDMFileBrowse
summary: Opens a standard file browser. Unlike the other`axlDM` functions, this always presents the user with a file browser. This function call blocks until the user selects a file or cancels.

name: axlDMFileError
summary: This returns the error from the last`axlDM`xxx call. Subsequent calls reset the error message so you should retrieve the error as soon as a call fails.

name: axlDMFileParts
summary: Breaks a filename into it's component parts.

name: axlDMFindFile
summary: Opens a file using Allegro PCB Editor conventions. Adds an extension and optionally looks it up in an Allegro PCB Editor search path.

name: axlDMGetFile
summary: Gets the file name`t_name` using Allegro PCB Editor conventions as described in the arguments. Returns the full path name of the file. Displays an error message if the file cannot be opened.

name: axlDMOpenFile
summary: Opens a file in conventional Allegro manner; adds an extension and optionally looks it up in an Allegro search path. Must have an entry in`fileops.txt` file.

name: axlDMOpenLog
summary: Opens a file for writing log messages. Uses the name of your program or application without an extension. Opens a file with that name and the extension`.log`. Returns the port of the file if it succeeds.

name: axlDRCGetCount
summary: Returns the total number of DRCs in the design. Note the design DRC may be out of date.

name: axlDRCItem
summary: Performs a DRC check on the indicated item(s). The`dbid` may be any `dbid` type (except the design). If the same item appears multiple times in the list, then the same DRC error(s) are returned, and the count is the sum of errors created by each `dbid`. The `g_mode` option controls two return options:

name: axlDRCUpdate
summary: Performs a DRC check on entire design.

name: axlDRCWaive
summary: Manages waive DRC state and access to the waive DRC functionality. It supports both waiving and restoring (unwaive) DRC markers. The interface supports both a single and a list of DRC`dbids`. If restoring a DRC marker, it will reappear but it may no longer reflect an actual DRC error. This may be due to:

name: axlDRCWaiveGetCount
summary: Returns total number of waived DRCs in the design.

name: axlDbidName
summary: Provides the standard Allegro PCB Editor name of a database object. Many of the named Allegro PCB Editor objects ( for example, nets) have names defined in the name attribute (for example,`dbid->name`) but other objects (for example, clines and pins) either do not have the desired reporting name or are unnamed.

name: axlDebug
summary: This enables/disables AXL debug mode. See`axlIsDebug` for description of what this entails.

name: axlDegToRad
summary: Converts an angle in degrees to radians.

name: axlDehighlightObject
summary: Use this command to turn off highlighting on an object. Dehighlights the objects whose`dbids` are in `lo_dbid`. If 'all option is used then g_permHighlight is treated as t (true).

name: axlDeleteAttachment
summary: Deletes the given attachment. If the attachment is password protected, the correct password must be given.

name: axlDeleteBondWire
summary: Deletes the (list of) bond wires passed in. Optionally, it will delete the connect bond finger elements as well.

name: axlDeleteByLayer
summary: Deletes all data on one or more provided layers. The following should be noted:

name: axlDeleteFillet
summary: Deletes fillet associated with a PIN, VIA, T, or CLINE. The command also deletes a single fillet if`o_dbid` is a fillet shape.

name: axlDeleteObject
summary: Deletes single or list of database objects from database. Deletion of components deletes the symbol owner as well. Deletion of nets is LOGIC only, and leaves the physical objects.

name: axlDeleteTaper
summary: Deletes tapers

name: axlDesignFlip
summary: Visually flips the design in the 'y' axis. Maintains current xy view.

name: axlDesignType
summary: Returns the type of design as a string.

name: axlDetailLoad
summary: This loads a the designated`ipf` file `(t_filename`) into the current design at location (point), with scaling (`f_scale`), rotation (`f_rotation`) and mirror (`g_mirror`). Items are clipped to rectangle provided a save file time. It will load the detail to the active layer.

name: axlDetailSave
summary: This saves a clipping box (l_bBox) and the passed set of geometries (lo_dbid) to a Allegro ipf file (t_filename).

name: axlDiffPair
summary: Creates, modifies, or deletes a differential pair. In all cases you can pass names or a`dbid`.

name: axlDiffPairAuto
summary: Allows automatic generation of the diffpair. Generates the set of diffpairs based on the provided positive (`t_posNetPostfix`) and negative (`t_negNetPostfix`) postfixes used in your net naming.

name: axlDiffPairDBID
summary: Returns the`dbid` of the named diffpair (`t_name`) if it exists in the database.

name: axlDistance
summary: Returns the distance between two points. You may use floating point.

name: axlDllCall
summary: Calls a symbol that has been imported from a plugin. As the first argument, it requires`o_pluginFunc` which was returned via a call to `axlDllSym`. The rest of the arguments are what the implement plugin API has defined.

name: axlDllCallList
summary: This function is identical to`axlDllCall` except it takes a list of arguments to pass to the plugin function. Unlike `axlDllCall,` which is limited to 10 arguments, this interface can take up to 512 arguments.

name: axlDllClose
summary: This closes an open plugin handle. Once a handle is closed, you can no longer call functions obtained from the plugin. Also, a plugin is automatically closed when there are no active references to it via Skill's garbage collection.

name: axlDllDump
summary: This is a debug function that reports all plugins loaded by Skill.

name: axlDllOpen
summary: This binds a dll/shared library to the current program. While this can load any dll, only those built to be compatible with the axl Plugin model can be utilized via Skill (seeDLL Programming for information on building compatible dlls).

name: axlDllSym
summary: This imports a symbol from a loaded dll. A dll can have one or more exported symbols. The symbol must have been exported from the dll when the dll was compiled and linked (See`axlDllDoc`).

name: axlDrawObject
summary: Processes a list of`dbids`.

name: axlDynamicsObject
summary: Adds list of objects to the cursor buffer. These objects are attached to the cursor in xor mode. Origin point establishes cursor position relative to objects in the dynamics buffer.

name: axlEmail
summary: Sends an e-mail. If multiple*To* or *Cc* addresses are required; separate their names with a semicolon (;). On Windows, a warning confirmer may generate. To disable the warning, add the following to the registry:

name: axlEndSkillMode
summary: Returns from the SKILL command mode to the program's command line. The SKILL exit function is mapped to this function. In a SKILL program this command has no effect.

name: axlEnterAngle
summary: Optionally prompts the user. Returns the angle value entered.

name: axlEnterBox
summary: Takes two points that define a box and returns them in`l_box`. Optionally prompts the user, if `l_prompts` contains no more than two strings. If `l_points` is `nil`, prompts for two points. If `l_points` contains one point, prompts only for the second point. If `l_points` contains both points, simply returns them as `l_box`.

name: axlEnterEvent
summary: A lower level event manager than other`axlEnter` functions. Provides a Skill program with more user event details. See Table 7-2 for a list of events with descriptions.

name: axlEnterPath
summary: Gets the start point and subsequent points for a path, interactively with optional prompting, or from the optional argument`l_points`. Sets the start point to the first value of `l_points`, if any, and the second point to the second value, if any. If `r_path` is given, connects the dynamic rubberband to its most recent segment. Use `axlEnterPath` recursively to build up the coordinates of a path interactively.

name: axlEnterPoint
summary: Prompts for and receives user-selected point. Returns the point data to the calling function.

name: axlEnterString
summary: Displays a dialog box that requires first entering a string, and then pressing*Return* on the keyboard or clicking *OK*or *Cancel.* Default prompt in the dialog box is `"Enter String."`You can supply a prompt string with the `?prompts` keyword. The function returns the string entered, if any. Otherwise it returns `nil`.

name: axlEraseObject
summary: Processes a list of`dbids` and erases them. Typically used with `axlDynamicsObject` to erase objects before attaching them to the cursor. Any objects erased are restored to their visibility when calling AXL shell or terminating the SKILL program.

name: axlEventSetStartPopup
summary: Sets a SKILL callback function called prior to a popup being displayed on the screen. Allows AXL applications to reset the popup (see`axlUIPOPUPSetsee`), thus providing context sensitive popups support.

name: axlExportXmlDBRecords
summary: This exports an Allegro Parameter file from the current design. It offers the same capability as (*File - Import - Parameter*). Side effect is creation of a `param_write.log` file.

name: axlExtentDB
summary: Determines a design type and returns the`bBox` extent. See axlExtentLayout and axlExtentSymbol for what Allegro PCB Editor considers an extent.

name: axlExtentLayout
summary: Obsolete. Use`axlExtentDB`. Kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlExtentSymbol
summary: Obsolete. UseaxlExtentDB. Kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlExtractMap
summary: Takes a set of Allegro database objects you select using the Allegro extract command file and applies to each object a SKILL function you have chosen. The extract command file (the *view*) selects the objects and also sets any filters. Ignores the output data fields listed in the extract command file, since it does not create an output file.

name: axlExtractToFile
summary: Extracts data from the current design into an ASCII file. Performs the same process as the Allegro batch command`a_extract`.

name: axlFillet
summary: Adds fillet between cline and pin/via, and at T. Removes and re-generates existing fillets. Fillet parameters are controlled from the Glossing**Pad and T Parameter** form.

name: axlFilletConvert
summary: Converts a fillet or taper to a static shape.

name: axlFilmCreate
summary: Creates a new artwork film or replaces an existing artwork film.

name: axlFindFilterIsOpen
summary: This function is no longer required, but is kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlFindPath
summary: Finds an etch path from one object to another. Items must be on the same net and must be connect type, such as, pins, vias, clines or shapes, and tee.

name: axlFinishEnterFun
summary: Terminates the wait for a user-selected point. Waiting function returns no data. For a one-point function (for example,`axlEnterPoint`) behaves the same as `axlCancelEnterFun`.

name: axlFlushDisplay
summary: Flushes all data from the display buffer to the display screen itself. Displays items intended to be displayed, but not yet displayed because no event has triggered a flush of the display buffer.

name: axlFormAutoResize
summary: Resizes a form to fit its controls. Recalculates the required width and height and resizes the form based on the current visibility of the form's fields.

name: axlFormBuildPopup
summary: This provides the ability to dynamically change popups of fields that have them. These fields are enum (or pop-up) and other fields that have a popup icon. Buttons, optionally, may also have a popup if they have a right arrow. Attempting this call on a field without a popup is an error.

name: axlFormCallback
summary: This is not a function but documents the callback interface for form interaction between a user and Skill code. The Skill program author provides this function.

name: axlFormClearMouseActive
summary: Clears the option to dispatch the MouseActive event on a form.

name: axlFormClose
summary: Closes the form`r_form`. Unless the form is running without a callback handler, you must make this call to close the form. Without a registered dispatch handler, Allegro PCB Editor closes the form automatically before returning to the application from `axlFormDisplay`.

name: axlFormColorize
summary: Allows the override of background and/or text color of a control. Only the following controls are supported:

name: axlFormCreate
summary: Creates a dialog based on the form descriptive file`t_formfile`. This call only supports forms of type `"fixed"` and fails if `t_formfile` contains any variable tiles. This function does not display the form. Use `axlFormDisplay` to display a form.

name: axlFormDefaultButton
summary: Forms normally automatically set a*default* *button* in a form with the `DEFAULT` section in the form file or with the *OK* and *DONE* labels. When the user hits a carriage return, the *default* *button* is executed.

name: axlFormDisplay
summary: Displays the form`r_form` already created by `axlFormCreate`. For superior display appearance, set all the field values of the form before calling this function. A form in blocking mode blocks until the user closes the form.

name: axlFormGetActiveField
summary: Gets the form's active field.

name: axlFormGetField
summary: Gets the value of`t_field` in the open form`r_form`. The value is a string if `g_stringOption` was set in`axlFormCreate`. Otherwise the value is in the field type declared in the form file.

name: axlFormGetFieldType
summary: Returns the control type for a form field. See the keywords inCallback Procedure: formCallback for a list of supported field types.

name: axlFormGridBatch
summary: Always used with`axlFormGridSetBatch`. Sets many grid cells efficiently.

name: axlFormGridCancelPopup
summary: After any change to grid content, the application must tell the grid that the changes are complete. The grid then updates itself to the user. Changes include: adding or deleting columns and changing cells.

name: axlFormGridDeleteRows
summary: Deletes`x_number` rows at `x_row` number. `x_row``=`,`n`>, `x_number``=-1` deletes the entire grid. `x_row``=-1`, `x_number``-1` may be used to delete the last row in the grid.

name: axlFormGridEvents
summary: Sets user events of interest. It is critical for your application to only set the events that you actually process since enabled events are scripted.

name: axlFormGridGetCell
summary: Returns grid cell data for a given row and column. All associated data for the cell is returned.

name: axlFormGridInsertCol
summary: Adds a column with the indicated options (`g_options`) to a grid field. The `g_options` parameter is based on the type `formGridCol`. The`formGridCol` structure has default behavior for all settings.

name: axlFormGridInsertRows
summary: Inserts`x_number`rows at `x_row` number location. Rows are inserted empty. A -1 may be used as `x_row` to add to end of the grid. Since grids are 1 based, a 1 inserts at the top of the grid.

name: axlFormGridNewCell
summary: Creates a new instance of`r_cell` which is required as input to axlFormGridBatch or axlFormSetField for form grid controls. As a convenience, the consuming APIs do not modify the cell attributes. You need not reset all attributes between API calls.

name: axlFormGridOptions
summary: Miscellaneous grid options. SeeUsing Grids for a grid overview.

name: axlFormGridReset
summary: Resets grid to its unloaded state. Application should then set the columns, then rows, to the same state as when they initially loaded the windows.

name: axlFormGridSelected
summary: This returns the selected item in a multi-select grid control. This should only be used if grid is running with the multi-select row option.

name: axlFormGridSelectedCnt
summary: This returns the count of rows selected in a multi-select grid control. This should only be used if grid is running with the multi-select row option.

name: axlFormGridSetBatch
summary: Changes grid cells much faster than`axlFormSetField` when changing multiple cells. Both APIs require a grid cell data type (`axlFormGridNewCell`.)

name: axlFormGridSetSelectRows
summary: This allows setting, clearing or toggling of selection state for a grid in multi-select row mode.

name: axlFormGridUpdate
summary: Unlike the form lists control you must manually notify the grid control that it must update itself. You should use this call in the following situations:

name: axlFormInvalidateField
summary: Invalidates the form's field. Allows Windows to send a redraw message to the field's redraw procedure.

name: axlFormIsFieldEditable
summary: Checks whether the given form field is editable. If the field is editable,`t` is returned. If the field is greyed, then `nil` is returned.

name: axlFormIsFieldVisible
summary: Determines whether a form field is visible.

name: axlFormListAddItem
summary: Adds an item to a list at position`x`. To add many items efficiently, pass the items as a list.

name: axlFormListDeleteAll
summary: Deletes all the items from the form list field,`t_field`*.* Use `axlFormListDeleteAll`to clear an entire list field to update it using `axlFormSetField`, then display it using `axlFormSetField` on the field with a `nil` field value.

name: axlFormListDeleteItem
summary: Deletes indicated item in the list. You can delete by a string or by position. Deleting by string works best if all items are unique. Position can be problematic if you have the list sort the items that you add to it.

name: axlFormListGetItem
summary: Returns the item in the list at index (`x_index`.) Lists start at index 0. If -1 is passed as an index, returns the last item in the list.

name: axlFormListGetSelCount
summary: This only applies to a multi-select list box (OPTIONS multiselect in form file). Returns a count of number of items selected in a multi-select list box.

name: axlFormListGetSelItems
summary: This only applies to a multi-select list box (OPTIONS multiselect in form file).

name: axlFormListOptions
summary: Sets options for a list control. The following options are supported:

name: axlFormListSelAll
summary: This only applies to a multi-select list box (OPTIONS multiselect in form file).

name: axlFormListSelect
summary: Highlights, and if not visible in the list, shows the designated item. Since Allegro PCB Editor forms permit only one item to be visible, it deselects any previously selected item. If`nil` is passed for `t_listItem` the list is reset to top and the selected list item is deselected.

name: axlFormMsg
summary: Retrieves and prints a message defined in the form file by message label (`t_messageLabel`.) Form file allows definitions of messages using the "`MESSAGE`" keyword (see Using Forms Specification Language.) Use this to give a user access to message text, but no access to your SKILL code.

name: axlFormRestoreField
summary: Restores the`t_field` in the open form `r_form` to its previous value. The previous value is only from the last user change and not from the form set field functions. This is only useful in the *form callback* function.

name: axlFormSetActiveField
summary: Makes the indicated field the active form field.

name: axlFormSetDecimal
summary: Sets the decimal precision for real fill-in fields in the form. If`g_field` is `nil`, sets the precision for all real fill-in fields in the form.

name: axlFormSetEventAction
summary: This function allows the user to register a callback function to be called whenever the user changes to a new active cell in the form. The callback registered during axlFormCreate dispatches events only when the user modifies a field value on the form (on exit from the field). This function allows the caller to receive an event when a field is first entered.

name: axlFormSetField
summary: Sets`t_field` to value `g_value` in open form `r_form`. Must pass the correct type, matching the entry in the form value or string type. Value type is dependent upon type of field type. For a complete discussion of field types, see the discussion at the front of this section.

name: axlFormSetFieldEditable
summary: Sets individual form fields to editable (`t)` or greyed (`nil`).

name: axlFormSetFieldLimits
summary: Sets the minimum or maximum values a user can enter in an integer or real fill-in field. If a`nil` value is provided, that limit is left unchanged.

name: axlFormSetFieldVisible
summary: Sets a form field to visible or invisible.

name: axlFormSetInfo
summary: Sets info`t_field` to value `t_value` in open form `r_form`. Unlike `axlFormSet`, user cannot change an info field.

name: axlFormSetMouseActive
summary: Sets the option to dispatch the MouseActive event on a form.

name: axlFormTest
summary: This is a development function for test purposes. Given a form file name this opens a form file to check for placement of controls. If form uses standard button names (for example,*ok, done, close, cancel*), you can close it be clicking the button. Otherwise, use the window control. If form is currently open, exposes form and returns.

name: axlFormTitle
summary: Overrides title of the form.

name: axlFormTreeViewAddItem
summary: Adds an item to a treeview under*parent* and after *insertAfter* sibling. If sibling is `nil`, the item is added as the last child of a parent. If parent is `nil`, item is created as the root of the tree.

name: axlFormTreeViewChangeImages
summary: Modifies various bitmap images associated with a given tree view item.

name: axlFormTreeViewChangeLabel
summary: Modifies text of a given treeview item.

name: axlFormTreeViewGetImages
summary: various bitmap image handles that refer to images used by a specified item in the tree view.

name: axlFormTreeViewGetLabel
summary: Returns text of a given treeview item.

name: axlFormTreeViewGetParents
summary: Returns a list of all the ancestors of a treeview control item, starting from the root of the tree. Helps in search operations in SKILL. Applications can traverse their tree list following parent lists to a given item instead of searching the whole tree for an item.

name: axlFormTreeViewGetSelectState
summary: In multi select mode, returns the select state of a treeview item. This is different than the current selected item in single select tree views. In multi select mode, users can change the select state by clicking on the select checkbox associated with each item.

name: axlFormTreeViewLoadBitmaps
summary: Allows an application to load one or more bitmaps into Allegro PCB Editor for use in specified tree view.

name: axlFormTreeViewSet
summary: Allows an application to change global and individual items in a tree view control.

name: axlFormTreeViewSetSelectState
summary: In multi select mode, sets the select state. This is different than the current selected item in single select tree views. In multi select mode, users can change the select state by clicking on the select checkbox associated with each item.

name: axlGRPDrwBitmap
summary: Loads a bitmap into a form draw window (drawing area in the graphics field). More drawing can take place on top of the bitmap.

name: axlGRPDrwCircle
summary: Draws a circle into the area identified by the`r_graphics` handle, at the origin specified, and with the specified radius. Option properties attached to the `r_graphics` handle are applied when drawing the circle.

name: axlGRPDrwInit
summary: Use this command to set graphics callback in a form field. It sets up necessary data structures for triggering the graphics callback into the graphics field.

name: axlGRPDrwLine
summary: Draws a line into the area identified by the`r_graphics` handle and the list of coordinates. Option properties attached to the `r_graphics` handle are applied when drawing the line.

name: axlGRPDrwMapWindow
summary: Forces a draw in a form draw field. Allows the application to denote the coordinate system that is mapped into the drawing area of the graphics field.

name: axlGRPDrwPoly
summary: Draws a polygon (multi-segment line) into the area identified by the`r_graphics` handle and the list of coordinates. Option properties attached to the `r_graphics` handle are applied when drawing the polygon. If the coordinates do not form a closed polygon, the first and last coordinates in the list are connected by a straight line.

name: axlGRPDrwRectangle
summary: Draws a rectangle into the area identified by the`r_graphics` handle and the `upper_left` and `lower_right` coordinates. Option properties attached to the `r_graphics` handle are applied when drawing the rectangle.

name: axlGRPDrwText
summary: Draws text into the area identified by the`r_graphics` handle at the origin specified. Option properties attached to the `r_graphics` handle are applied when drawing the text.

name: axlGRPDrwUpdate
summary: Force call to register callback function for a draw window. Triggers calling of the application supplied callback function.

name: axlGeo2Str
summary: When converting floating point numbers to strings you may find the number printed is slightly differently then the value Allegro reports. This is difference is due to how floating point numbers are represented in the computer. The following article is an excellent paper on the subject:*What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic* by David Goldberg.

name: axlGeoArcCenterAngle
summary: Calculates the center of an arc given the angle between its endpoints. Uses the arguments depending on`g_clockwise` as shown in Figure 25-1.

name: axlGeoArcCenterRadius
summary: Calculates center of an arc given its radius. Calculates`l_center` either for one arc or another depending on the arguments, as shown.

name: axlGeoEqual
summary: Performs an equal comparison between two floating point numbers and determines if they are equal within plus or minus the current database accuracy.

name: axlGeoPointInShape
summary: Given a point and a shape`dbid`, determines whether that point is inside or outside the shape or a polygon. For a shape with voids, a point is considered *outside* the given shape if inside a void. If shape has voids and g_include_voids is t then point is outside if inside a void.

name: axlGeoPointShapeInfo
summary: Given a point and a shape dbid returns relation of point to shape. State may be outside, inside or on. Additional dbid is returned in the second argument to indicate if void or shape is involved.

name: axlGeoPointsEqual
summary: This performs an equal comparison between two xy points and determines if they are equal within db accuracy.

name: axlGeoRotatePt
summary: Rotates*xy* about an origin by angle. Optionally applies mirror on the *x* axis.

name: axlGetActiveLayer
summary: Retrieves active class and subclass of the design.

name: axlGetActiveTextBlock
summary: Gets the current active text block, equivalent to the status dialog box.

name: axlGetAlias
summary: Requests the value of the specified Allegro PCB Editor alias,`t_alias`. If given a `nil`, returns a list of aliases currently set. For compatibility purposes, `axlGetAlias` returns funckey settings.

name: axlGetAllAttachmentNames
summary: Returns a list of the ids for all database attachments in the current Allegro PCB Editor database. If no attachments are present, then`nil` is returned. The attachments can retrieved using the axlGetAttachment`()` function.

name: axlGetAllViaList
summary: Returns a list of all padstacks included in via lists in the design. This is a compilation of all via lists from all constraint sets. Optionally it provides padstacks from net VIA_LIST properties.

name: axlGetAllVisibleProfiles
summary: Returns a list of all the bond wire profiles currently visible in the design.

name: axlGetAttachment
summary: Returns the database attachment with the given id. If the attachment exists, an*attachment record* is returned containing information about the attachment. The data is in the format specified by the `s_dataFormat` argument. If `'file` format, then the `data` attribute contains a temporary file name to which the data was written. If `'string`, then the `data` attribute contains the attachment data itself. If the `s_dataFormat` argument is omitted or is `nil`, then the `data` attribute is `nil`.

name: axlGetDieData
summary: Gets the data for the given die and loads it into the a defstruct.

name: axlGetDieStackData
summary: Gets the data for the given die-stack and loads it into a defstruct.

name: axlGetDieStackMemberSet
summary: Returns a list of defstructs - one for each member of the given die stack.

name: axlGetDieStackNames
summary: Returns a list of the names of all die stacks in the current design.

name: axlGetDieType
summary: Returns the die attachment type for a given die component in a Cadence packaging tool (APD/SIP). A die is considered to be an IC class component in the database. Currently, the supported attachment types include the following:

name: axlGetDrawingName
summary: Retrieves the full path of the drawing.

name: axlGetDynamicsSegs
summary: Normally used with dynamics to calculate arc tangency of two picks to a current`r_path`. Passed coordinates may be modified to preserve tangency. Depends on the current line lock state that you set or `axlSetLineLock`.

name: axlGetFindFilter
summary: Returns the current Find Filter settings as a list`pf` keyword strings. The return find filters settings (onButton or enabled) is controlled by the boolean `onEnabledF`

name: axlGetFuncKey
summary: Requests the value of the specified funckey,`t_alias`. If given `nil`, returns a list of currently set funckeys.

name: axlGetImpedance
summary: Returns minimum and maximum impedance for given item. Item can be either cline, cline segment, net or xnet. Impedance is in ohms by default.

name: axlGetIposerData
summary: This function fetches the data for the given iposer and loads it into a defstruct.

name: axlGetLastEnterPoint
summary: Gets the last pick location from`axlEnterPoint`.

name: axlGetLineLock
summary: Gets the current settings of the line lock or dynamic control options. Equivalent items is the option control panel for "add" commands. Items currently supported:

name: axlGetMetalUsageForLayer
summary: Computes the percentage metal coverage on the layers specified in l_layer(s) (combination of all layers listed) in the area specified in`l_extents`. If no extents are provided, then the geometry outline extents of the design are used.

name: axlGetModuleInstanceDefinition
summary: AXL interface to the C function that returns the name of the module definition used to create the module instance.

name: axlGetModuleInstanceLocation
summary: AXL interface to the C function that gets the current location of the module instance in the design.

name: axlGetModuleInstanceLogicMethod
summary: AXL interface to the C function that determines the logic method used by the module instance.

name: axlGetModuleInstanceNetExceptions
summary: AXL interface to the C function that gets the net exception of the module instance in the design.

name: axlGetParam
summary: Gets the parameter`dbid` for a named object. Supported parameter names are shown below. For descriptions of attributes of a parameter, see are Chapter 2, "The Allegro PCB Editor Database User Model."

name: axlGetSelSet
summary: Gets the list of object`dbids` in the select set.

name: axlGetSelSetCount
summary: Returns the number of figure`dbids` in the select set.

name: axlGetSpacerData
summary: Gets the data for the given spacer and loads it into a defstruct.

name: axlGetTrapBox
summary: Returns coordinates of the*Find* window.

name: axlGetVariable
summary: Requests the value of the specified Allegro PCB Editor environment variable,`t_variable`. Returns a list containing the string assigned to the variable or `nil` if the variable is currently not set in Allegro PCB Editor. Use `axlGetVariableList` where the variable stores a list of items (such as a PATH variable) to preserve any spaces in each item.

name: axlGetVariableList
summary: Requests the value of the specified Allegro PCB Editor environment variable,`t_variable`. Unlike `axlGetVariable` this returns a list of strings, if the variable is an array, such as one of Allegro PCB Editor`s path variables. If variable is a single item, the return is the same as `axlGetVariable`.

name: axlGetWireProfileColor
summary: This function will retrieve the color index associated with a bond wire profile. If no profile matching the name supplied is found in the database, nil is returned.

name: axlGetWireProfileDefinition
summary: Given a bonding wire profile name, this will returns its definition information.

name: axlGetWireProfileDirection
summary: This function returns the direction of a wire profile definition defined in the database. Profiles may be either forward or reverse. If the profile definition name provided does not exist in the design, the return value will be`nil`.

name: axlGetWireProfileVisible
summary: This function will retrieve the visibility status of a bond wire profile. If no profile matching the name supplied is found in the database, nil is returned.

name: axlGetXSection
summary: * This is obsolete, use new axlXSectionGet() family of APIs. The command will be maintained for older SKILL code but it will not be enhanced to support new dataReturns a list of all layers in the cross section found in the current drawing.

name: axlHighlightObject
