summary: Highlights the figures whose`dbids` are in `lo_dbid`.

name: axlHistory
summary: * ***This is a developers aid only. Do NOT use it in a Skill program.***

name: axlHttp
summary: Displays a URL from Allegro PCB Editor in an external web browser. First attempts to use the last active window of a running web browser, raising the browser window to the top if required. If no browser is running, tries to start one.

name: axlISProductStarted
summary: * ***This should not be used, useaxlLicIsProductEnabled.***

name: axlImpdedanceGetLayerBroadsideDPImp
summary: Computes the differential impedance of a broadside-coupled diffpair with the given line width and two specified layers on which the signal lines will be routed. A warning message may be given if the parameters are inappropriate for the calculation.

name: axlImpdedanceGetLayerBroadsideDPWidth
summary: Computes the differential impedance of a broadside-coupled diffpair with the given line width and two specified layers on which the signal lines will be routed. A warning message may be given if the parameters are inappropriate for the calculation.

name: axlImpdedanceGetLayerEdgeDPImp
summary: Computes the differential impedance of a edge-coupled diffpair with the given line width and spacing on a specified layer. A warning message may be given if the parameters are inappropriate for the calculation.

name: axlImpdedanceGetLayerEdgeDPSpacing
summary: Given the line width of the two signal lines of an edge-coupled diffpair on the specified layer, finds the spacing such that the differential impedance is closest to the target value. A warning message may be given if the parameters are inappropriate for the calculation.

name: axlImpdedanceGetLayerEdgeDPWidth
summary: Given the spacing of the two signal lines of an edge-coupled diffpair on the specified layer, finds the line width such that the differential impedance is closest to the target value. A warning message may be given if the parameters are inappropriate for the calculation.

name: axlImpedance2Width
summary: Converts the given impedance on a specified layer to a line width.

name: axlImportWireProfileDefinitions
summary: This function will import the bond wire profiles defined in the xml file specified. If a profile is defined both in the XML file and in the current design, the design's definition will be updated to match the new definition being imported.

name: axlImportXmlDBRecords
summary: This command imports an Allegro Parameter file into the current design. It offers the same capability as (*File - Import - Parameter*). A side effect is creation of `param_read.log` file.

name: axlInTrigger
summary: Tests if the application or the utility in a axlTrigger callback. Returns`t` if currently in a trigger call. This function is only required in rare cases when you might have a utility that you want to run differently if called as part of a axlTrigger callback.

name: axlInTriggerFunc
summary: If in a trigger callback, reports trigger function symbol.`nil`, if not in a trigger callback.

name: axlIsAttachment
summary: Determines if the given object is an AXL attachment.

name: axlIsBetween
summary: Used to check if a given point lies between two specified points. Returns`t` if the point is in between the two points or on one of the points.

name: axlIsCustomColored
summary: If object has custom color, will return the object custom color, otherwise nil.

name: axlIsDBIDType
summary: Determines if`g_dbid` is an Allegro PCB Editor database `dbid`. Returns `t` if so and `nil` otherwise.

name: axlIsDebug
summary: This checks if AXL debug mode is enabled. This is associated with the`axldebug` Allegro environment variable.

name: axlIsDummyNet
summary: Determines if a given net is a Dummy net. Name of net is an empty string ("").

name: axlIsEtchLayer
summary: Determines if a layer is associated with the ETCH layers. Returns`t` if layer is associated with any of te ETCH layers -- `ETCH`, `PIN`,`VIA`, `DRC`, `VIA_KEEPOUT`, `ROUTE_KEEPOUT`, `ANTI_ETCH`, `BOUNDARY`, `CONSTRAINT_REGION`, `ROUTER_PLAN`, and `CAVITY`

name: axlIsFormType
summary: Tests if argument`g_form` is a form `dbid`.

name: axlIsGridCellType
summary: Tests the passed symbol to see if its user type is of the form`"grid cell".`

name: axlIsHighlighted
summary: If the object is permanently highlighted returns the highlight color; otherwise`nil`.

name: axlIsLayer
summary: Determines if the`t_layer` exists. `t_layer` is a fully qualified layer name.

name: axlIsLayerNegative
summary: Determines whether or not the given plane layer is negative.

name: axlIsPinUnused
summary: Determines if the given pin is unused, indicating that it is on a dummy net.

name: axlIsPointInsideBox
summary: Returns`t` if a point is inside or on the edge of a box. Also see axlGeoPointInShape for `dbid`-based tests. You may use floating point.

name: axlIsPointOnLine
summary: Returns`t` if point is on a given line or `nil` if not on the line.

name: axlIsPolyType
summary: Tests if argument`g_polygon` is a polygon user type.

name: axlIsProductLineActive
summary: This routine determines if a product in a given product line has been started.

name: axlIsProtectAlias
summary: Tests if the alias is read-only (or writeable). This may also be used with funckeys.

name: axlIsSymbolEditor
summary: Returns`t` if in symbol editor, `nil` for all other editors.

name: axlIsViewFileType
summary: Tests whether`g_userType` is a long message window type.

name: axlIsVisibleLayer
summary: Returns the visibility (`t/nil`) of a fully qualified layer.

name: axlIsitFill
summary: Determines if fill shape is allowed for a given class subclass.

name: axlJournal
summary: This function manages the program's journal file. It has several modes of operation:

name: axlKillDesign
summary: Same as (`axlOpenDesign``<``unnamed``> "wf"`), where <`unnamed`>is the standard Allegro PCB Editor name provided for an unnamed design. If the specific name is important, you can determine it using the axlCurrentDesign command.

name: axlLastPick
summary: This returns the last processed cursor pick. You can snap to current grid (`l_mode` ) ⇒`t`) or leave it unsnapped. Position is returned in design units. The grid used depends on the active layer. A pick event causes the last pick. In Skill, a call to axlEnterPoint, axlEnterEvent, etc. may generate this. It allows switching from a snapped to an unsnapped event. If a user has made no pick since launching Allegro PCB Editor, then it returns `(0 0`).

name: axlLastPickIsSnapped
summary: Normally called after an`axlEnter` call to determine if the pick was snapped or unsnapped.

name: axlLayerCreateCrossSection
summary: This is obsolete, useaxlXSectionCreate.

name: axlLayerCreateNonConductor
summary: Creates a new subclass for non-etch subclasses. AXL-SKILL restricts you from creating etch subclasses.

name: axlLayerDelete
summary: This command deletes a cross section layer. WhileaxlDeleteObject can be used to delete empty named layers, this API can delete both named and unnamed cross-section layers.The cross section has both ETCH layers and unnamed dielectric layers.The order of the cross section is returned by axlGetXSection, The `x_layerNumber` is the order within the cross-section with the first index number (e.g AIR) starting at 0.

name: axlLayerGet
summary: Gets the layer parameter given the shortcut notation of*<*`class`*>*/*<*`subclass`*>*. This is an ease of use function that does:

name: axlLayerPriorityClearAll
summary: Clears all layer priority information in Allegro database. UseaxlLayerPrioritySet for usage.

name: axlLayerPriorityGet
summary: Obtains layer priority, where 0 is normal (not set). Priority can range from 1 (highest) to 255 (lowest).

name: axlLayerPriorityRestoreAll
summary: Restores previously saved layer priority information. This function only works if a call toaxlLayerPrioritySaveAll has been done already.

name: axlLayerPrioritySaveAll
summary: Saves all layer priority information to be restored later. Until aaxlLayerPriorityRestoreAll is called, any subsequent calls to this function are no-op.

name: axlLayerPrioritySet
summary: This changes the drawing priority of given layer. Priority is from 1 (highest) to 255 (lowest). Layers without priority in standard drawing order below all priority layers. The active layer is always drawn first.

name: axlLayerSet
summary: Updates changes to layer parameters. You can only update the color and visibility attributes of a parameter. This is a wrapper for`axlSetParam`. After completing color or visibility changes, call `axlVisibleUpdate` to update the display.

name: axlLayerViaLabel
summary: Reports via label for a layer. A via label either defaults to the layer number, or can be assigned by the user through the cross section. You can query the cross section for an override.

name: axlLicDefaultVersion
summary: This returns the default version number used in licensing. Most applications in a release will use this version number when checking out licenses.

name: axlLicFeatureExists
summary: Checks if license feature exists. Does not verify that the license is available. If no version is provided, the tool default version (seeaxlLicDefaultVersion) is used.

name: axlLicIsProductEnabled
summary: Checks if license is checked-out by tool.

name: axlLineSlope
summary: Returns the slope of a line. You may use floating point.

name: axlLineXLine
summary: This function is no longer required, but is kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlLoadPadstack
summary: Loads a padstack by attempting to find the padstack by name in the existing database. Failing that, Allegro PCB Editor looks in the pad library on the disk.

name: axlLoadSymbol
summary: Searches for indicated symbol in database. If not present, searches PSMPATH and loads the symbol into the database. In the symbol editor, this can only be used for shape and mechanical symbols for use with padstacks.

name: axlLogHeader
summary: Writes the standard Allegro PCB Editor log file header to the passed open file. The header record includes:

name: axlMKS2UU
summary: Converts between an MKS string to the current database user units. String can be any length name plus many common abbreviations (see`units.dat` file in the Allegro PCB Editor share/text hierarchy for supported names.)

name: axlMKSAlias
summary: Searches the MKS unit database for the current definition associated with`unitName`. Unlike `axlMKSConvert`, this function does not convert.

name: axlMKSConvert
summary: Converts any allowable unit to any other allowable unit. It operates in several ways, depending on the arguments.

name: axlMKSStr2UU
summary: Converts an input string to a MKS string in current database units. If the input string is in MKS units, that is used as the basis for the conversion. If the string has no units, the function uses the default database units for the string.

name: axlMPythag
summary: Calculates distance between two points using pythagoras. This is faster then building this code in Skill.

name: axlMUniVector
summary: This calculates a unit-vector. A unit vector allows one to calculate points additional points along that line.

name: axlMXYAdd
summary: This does a`l_pt1 + lpt2` and returns the result.

name: axlMXYMult
summary: This is a convenience function that does a`l_pt.x * f_factor` and `lpt.y * factor` and returns the result. If provided an origin, it adds the origin.

name: axlMXYSub
summary: This does a`l_pt1 - lpt2` and returns the result.

name: axlMapClassName
summary: Use this function to write a SKILL program that runs in Allegro PCB Editor and APD. You can map from class names to the name appropriate to the program running your SKILL program. For example, you can write a program using Allegro PCB Editor class names and have the program run in APD.

name: axlMatchGroupAdd
summary: Adds members to a matched group. Eligible members are:

name: axlMatchGroupCreate
summary: Creates a new match group. If a match group already exists with the same name,`nil` is returned. Match groups need to be populated, or they are deleted when saving. Use the axlMatchGroupAdd command to populate the match groups.

name: axlMatchGroupDelete
summary: This deletes a match group. The command fails in product tiers that do not support electrical constraints or the symbol editor.

name: axlMatchGroupProp
summary: Adds or removes the RELATIVE_PROPAGATION_DELAY property from a member of a match group. Property must be a legal RPD syntax that includes the RPD name.

name: axlMatchGroupRemove
summary: Removes elements from an existing match group. Elements must be members (attribute groupMembers) of the match group.

name: axlMaterialGet
summary: Returns various infomation about materials file. Depending on the argument passed, command works in different modes to retrieve the following.

name: axlMathDotProduct
summary: This calculates the dot or scaler product.

name: axlMemSize
summary: Returns an estimate of memory use. Returns not what the program is*using*, rather what it is *requesting* from the operating system.

name: axlMeterCreate
summary: Starts progress meter with optional cancel feature.

name: axlMeterDestroy
summary: Closes the progress meter form and shuts off Cancel mode if enabled.

name: axlMeterIsCancelled
summary: If cancel was enabled at meter creation, the status of cancel is returned (`t` if cancelled; otherwise `nil`).

name: axlMeterUpdate
summary: Updates progress meter bar and/or info text. The percent done and/or the info string may be updated.

name: axlMidPointArc
summary: Returns mid-point on a arc. Note mid-point may not be on a database coordinate. All parameters may be obtained from a arc dbid.

name: axlMidPointLine
summary: Returns mid-point of line. Note mid-point might not be a database coordinate.

name: axlMiniStatusLoad
summary: Loads the Ministatus form with the form file provided in this call. Replaces the current Ministatus form contents. This function is a special case of`axlForms`. See Chapter 11, "Form Interface Functions," for details on how AXL forms work.

name: axlMiniStatusReset
summary: This resets the Option panel settings and find filter settings to a new design's default.

name: axlMsgCancelPrint
summary: Prints a message informing the user that he requested*cancel*. Since the severity of this message is *Error* (3), AXL writes it to the context buffer as it does other warning, error, and fatal messages. Call this function only from a routine that requests user input.

name: axlMsgCancelSeen
summary: Checks to see if the`axlMsgCancelPrint` message was printed. Does not poll the input stream for a *CANCEL* key. Checks the buffer of current messages for the occurrence of the `axlSsgSys.cancelRequest` message.

name: axlMsgClear
summary: Clears the current error severity level. You can reset the severity by first saving it using`axlMsgTest`, then setting it using `axlMsgSet`.

name: axlMsgContextClear
summary: Clears the buffered messages for a context.

name: axlMsgContextFinish
summary: Indicates the finish of a message context. Prints any buffered messages in the context and clears the context buffer.

name: axlMsgContextGet
summary: Gets the format strings of the buffered messages. (Not the messages themselves. Compare the example here and the one shown for `axlMsgContextGetString`.) Does not remove the messages from the message buffer, rather it simply provides the caller an alternative to making a number of `axlMsgContextInBuf` calls.

name: axlMsgContextGetString
summary: Gets the messages in the message buffer and removes them from the buffer. Call`axlMsgContextGetString` subsequently to communicate those messages to the user (for example, in a log file).

name: axlMsgContextInBuf
summary: Checks whether message`t_format_string` is in the message buffer of context `r_context`. Gives the application the ability to control code flow based on a particular message reported by a called function. The check is based on the original format string, not the fully substituted message.

name: axlMsgContextPrint
summary: Prints the buffered messages and removes them from the message buffer.

name: axlMsgContextRemove
summary: Removes a message (or messages) from the buffered messages. Lets you remove messages (usually warnings) from the buffer that you decide, later in a procedure, that you do not want the user to see.

name: axlMsgContextStart
summary: Indicates the start of a message context. Prints any buffered messages for the context.

name: axlMsgContextTest
summary: Returns the most severe message class of the messages in the context message buffer. SeeaxlMsgContextInBuf to check for a particular message class.

name: axlMsgPut
summary: Puts a message in the journal file. Use this function to "print" messages. It buffers any errors or warnings, but processes other message classes immediately.

name: axlMsgSet
summary: Sets the current error severity level. Use only to reset the severity cleared using`axlMsgClear`.

name: axlMsgTest
summary: Determines the current error severity level. Returns a single number giving the severity level of the most severe message that has been printed since the last`axlMsgClear` or `axlMsgContextClear`/`Print`/`GetMsg` call.

name: axlNetClassAdd
summary: Adds members to a netclass group. Eligible members are:

name: axlNetClassCreate
summary: This creates a new netclass group. If a netclass exists with this name then`nil` is returned. Net Classes need to be populated via `axlNetClassAdd`. Empty net classes may be deleted on database save. A netclass must be part of one or more domains. These domains are shown below. The Same Net Constraint domain uses the netclass spacing domain. An object (bus, diffpair, xnet or net) may be a member of single netclass in a domain. For example, if net VCC exists in the POWER netclass in the physical domain then you cannot add it to another netclass in the physical domain. You can still add this net of a netclass in the spacing or electrical domain. You can obtain the current set of netclasses in the database via: `axlDBGetDesign()->netclass`. axlNetClassGet reports if an object is a member of a netclass either directly or via the logic hierarchy.

name: axlNetClassDelete
summary: This deletes a net class group. It does not delete the objects belonging to the group. It is up to the application code to update DRC.

name: axlNetClassGet
summary: Given a dbid (net, xnet, diffpair or bus) and a domain (spacing, physical or electrical) return its netclass. If g_hierarchical is nil, returns object's netclass if a direct member. If g_hierarchal=t returns first netclass encountered in logical hierarchy. For example, if a net is a member of a bus and the bus is assigned to netclass, BUSCLASS, and you pass a net of the bus to this API:

name: axlNetClassRemove
summary: Removes elements from an existing net class group. Element must currently be a direct member of the group. This will mark DRC out of date. It is up to the application to update the DRC system.

name: axlNetEcsetValueGet
summary: Returns the value of a specific electrical constraint that has been assigned to a given net. Both fixed and user defined constraints may be accessed. This will not return a "flattened" net view of constraints applied to pinpairs. Use`axlCnsNetFlattened` to obtain this constraint view.

name: axlNetSched
summary: This is the main routine that the command processor calls for the`net schedule` command.

name: axlOK2Void
summary: Determines if voids are allowed for a given`class/subclass`. Determines if a layer supports voids for shapes.

name: axlOKToProceed
summary: Checks whether Allegro PCB Editor is processing another interactive command or engaged in some process that might interfere with a SKILL command. Use this to check before starting functions such as`dbcreate`, user interactions, and select set operations. Returns `t` if Allegro PCB Editor is ready to properly execute a SKILL command, and returns `nil` if it is not.

name: axlOSBackSlash
summary: This changes UNIX style forward slashes to DOS style backslashes. While most applications support either style, certain older Windows applications only support DOS style path.

name: axlOSControl
summary: Inquires and/or sets the value dealing with the graphics. If setting a value, the return is the old value of the control.

name: axlOSFileCopy
summary: Copies a given source file to a given destination with optional append.

name: axlOSFileMove
summary: Moves the given source file to the given destination.

name: axlOSNtp
summary: Reports time from a NTP server.

name: axlOSSlash
summary: Changes DOS style backslashes to UNIX style slashes which are more amenable to SKILL. On UNIX, returns the incoming string.

name: axlOpenDesign
summary: Opens a design. The new design replaces the current design. If the current design has unsaved edits, you are asked to confirm before discarding them unless the current design was opened in "`r`" mode (not supported in this release) or unless `g_mode` is "`wf"`. If you cancel the confirmer, the function returns `nil` and the current design remains open.

name: axlOpenDesignForBatch
summary: Opens a design. The new design replaces the current design. Since this is for batch usage, commands and menus are not changed. If the current design has unsaved edits, then you are asked to confirm the discard unless the current design was opened in`"r"` mode (not supported in this release) or `g_mode` is `"wf"`. If you cancel the confirmer, then the function returns `nil` and the current design is left open.

name: axlOpenFindFilter
summary: This function is no longer required, but is kept for backward compatibility.

name: axlPPrint
summary: Converts a string with Allegro PCB Editor's pretty print text function as follows:

name: axlPackageDesignCheckAddCategory
summary: This function will register a new category inside the IC Packaging tools' "package integrity" command check tree.

name: axlPackageDesignCheckAddCheck
summary: This function will register a new check in the specified category of the IC Packaging tools' "package integrity" command check tree.

name: axlPackageDesignCheckDrcError
summary: This function will create an external DRC marker for an error found by the currently running package integrity check. The tool itself will track the check being run so that it knows the name to use for the rule violation.

name: axlPackageDesignCheckLogError
summary: This function will log an error found by this function to the log file if the log file is enabled. By using this interface, you are ensuring that the API will format your message consistently.

name: axlPadFigureTypes
summary: Returns list of strings of supported pad figure types.Not all pad types and layers may support a figure type. This is a documentation support function.

name: axlPadOnLayer
summary: Tests if a pad is present on an etch layer. A pad is present on the layer if the padstack has a regular, anti or thermal pad and it is not suppressed by the rules of Pad Suppression.

name: axlPadSuppressGet
summary: Returns pad suppress layer characteristic for a layer or design. Pad suppression is not available in symbol editor.

name: axlPadSuppressOkLayer
summary: Indicates if layer can be set for pad suppression. Only internal conductor and shape layers that are not set for negative artwork, support pad suppression.

name: axlPadSuppressSet
summary: This modifies the pad suppression settings in the design. Allows control of both dynamic suppression setting (g_mode) and the individual layer options (subsequent arguments).

name: axlPadUserMaskLayers
summary: Supports following modes:

name: axlPadstackEdit
summary: Inquire and set display options. Edits global settings of an existing padstack.

name: axlPadstackSetType
summary: Changes a padstack type. In its 2 argument mode is the same as:

name: axlPadstackToDisk
summary: Saves a board padstack out to a library.

name: axlPadstackUsageTypes
summary: Returns list of strings of supported padstack usage types. This is a documentation support function.

name: axlParamFilletDoc
summary: This function supports access to the fillet parameter record. The database is updated whenaxlSetParam is called.

name: axlPathArcCenter
summary: Each of these functions provides a way to construct an arc segment from the current endpoint of`r_path` to the given `l_end_point` in the direction specified by the Boolean `g_clockwise`, as described below and shown in Figure 15-1.

name: axlPathGetLastPathSeg
summary: Gets the last segment of a path structure.

name: axlPathGetPathSegs
summary: Gets a list of the segments of a path structure, in the order they appear in the path.

name: axlPathGetWidth
summary: Gets the default width of an existing path structure.

name: axlPathLine
summary: Adds a single straight line segment to the end of an existing`r_path` structure as specified by the arguments. Start point of the line is the last point in `r_path`.

name: axlPathOffset
summary: Adds an offset,`xy`, to all points within a `r_path`.

name: axlPathSegGetArcCenter
summary: Gets the center point of a path arc segment.

name: axlPathSegGetArcClockwise
summary: Gets the clockwise flag (`t` or `nil`) of a path segment.

name: axlPathSegGetEndPoint
summary: Gets the end point of an existing path structure.

name: axlPathSegGetWidth
summary: Gets the width of a single segment in a path structure.

name: axlPathStart
summary: Creates a new path with a startpoint and one or more segments as specified by the list`l_points` and returns the path `dbid`. You can add more straight-line and arc segments to the returned `r_path` using the `axlPathArc` and `axlPathLine` functions described in this section. Once`r_path` has all the segments you require, create the actual database figure using the appropriate `axlDBCreate` function, with `r_path` as one of the arguments.

name: axlPathStartCircle
summary: Creates an`axlPath` structure (`r_path`) for a circle.

name: axlPdfView
summary: Displays a PDF file from Allegro PCB Editor. If just the filename is given, attempts to find the PDF file using Allegro PCB Editor's`PDFPATH` variable. Displays the PDF file in an external PDF viewer.

name: axlPinExport
summary: This exports all pins in the symbol editor in csv format. The format of the csv file is described inaxlPinImport.

name: axlPinImport
summary: This imports pin csv (comma separated values) file into the symbol editor. With this file you can describe the location and other characteristics of a set of pins (including mechanical) that comprise a symbol.

name: axlPinPair
summary: This creates or deletes a pinpair. A pinpair consists of two un-ordered pins or ratTs on the same net. For example, pinpair`u1.2:r1.2` is the same pinpair as `r1.2:u1.2`. If the pinpair already exists then the existing pinpair is returned. The command fails in product tiers that do not support electrical constraints or the symbol editor.

name: axlPinPairSeek
summary: Given two pins or ratTs reports if they are part of a pinpair.

name: axlPinsOfNet
summary: Returns list of pins and ratTs on a net or xnet. First argument can be either a net, xnet`dbid` or a net name (xnet names are not supported). Second option, `g_mode`, can be `'pin` to return only the pins, `'ratT` to return list of ratTs or nil to return both pins and ratTs. There is no meaning conveyed in the list of items returned.

name: axlPolyErrorGet
summary: Retrieves the error from the logop core. See the following list of error strings returned by the logical operation core:

name: axlPolyExpand
summary: This function yields a list of polys after expanding them by a specified distance. Use of a negative number causes contraction. Distance is specified in user units. This function does not allow hole polys as input. When holes are passed as input, the following warning is displayed:

name: axlPolyFromDB
summary: Creates a list of`o_polygon` objects from the `dbid`or an `r_path`. Use the `lo_polygon` list to get the poly attributes or to perform logical operations on these polys. In the case of r_path option, we expect a path that reflects a closed shape with no intersections. It is important that the first and last point be the same. The width option of `r_path` is ignored as well as the '?' arguments to `axlPolyFromDB.`

name: axlPolyFromHole
summary: Creates a new poly from the vertices of the hole, and sets the`isHole` attribute of the resulting poly to `nil`. Function returns `nil` in case of error.

name: axlPolyMemUse
summary: This returns a list of integers reflecting the internal memory use of the`axlPoly` interfaces. If you assign Poly objects to global handles (instead of assigning to locals, e.g `let` or `prog` statements) then you need to insure all of global data is `nil`-ed at the end of your program. The example below shows how to check that you have written your program correctly.

name: axlPolyOffset
summary: This offsets the entire poly by the provided xy coordinate. Optionally if`g_copy` is `t`it will copy the poly, default is to offset the provided poly.

name: axlPolyOperation
summary: Performs the logical operation specified on the two sets of polygons. Does not allow hole polygons as input. When holes are passed as input, the following warning is displayed:

name: axlPrintDbid
summary: This is a debug function to print one or a list of dbids. Output format is terse and parsable. This will not print all attribute data in a dbid but is customized to aid in understanding the dbid data.

name: axlProtectAlias
summary: Controls the read-only attribute of an alias.

name: axlPurgePadstacks
summary: Purges unused padstacks from the database in the area controlled by`S_mode` symbol.

name: axlRadToDeg
summary: Converts an angle in radians to degrees.

name: axlRatsnestBlank
summary: Blanks all ratsnest lines in a net.

name: axlRatsnestDisplay
summary: Displays all ratsnest lines in a net.

name: axlReadOnlyVariable
summary: This sets, unsets or queries the read-only state of a Allegro PCB Editor environment variable. When you set a variable as read-only, it cannot be changed.

name: axlRecursiveDelete
summary: Recursively removes directories and subdirectories in the argument list. Directory is emptied of files and removed. If the removal of a non-empty, write-protected directory is attempted, the utility fails. If it encounters protected files or sub-directories, it does not remove them or the parent directories, but removes all other objects.

name: axlRefreshSymbol
summary: Refreshes a symbol from file on disk which is located by current PSMPATH. Works the same as the refresh_symbol functionality except updates one symbol definition. Unlike refresh_symbol this does not support the reset custom drill option since this is done at the padstack level not the symbol level.

name: axlRegexpIs
summary: Determines whether an environment variable expression contains Allegro PCB Editor compatible wildcard characters. Certain select-by-name functions support wildcard characters. You can test for the presence of wildcards before calling the select-by-name type of functions.

name: axlRegionAdd
summary: Adds members to a region group. Eligible members are:

name: axlRegionCreate
summary: Creates a new region group. If a region exists with this name then`nil` is returned. Regions may contain shapes on CONS_REGION class. Shapes are added to the region group via the axlRegionAdd. Empty regions may be deleted on database save. You can obtain the current set of regions in the database via: `axlDBGetDesign()->region`. None of the region APIs are enabled in the PCB L product.

name: axlRegionDelete
summary: This deletes a region group. It does not delete the objects belonging to the group.

name: axlRegionRemove
summary: Removes shapes from an existing region group. Element must currently be a direct member of the group. This will mark DRC out of date. It is up to the application to update the DRC system.

name: axlRemoveNet
summary: Removes a net. May either give a string with the net name to be renamed or`dbid` of an object on that net.

name: axlRenameDesign
summary: Changes the current design name. Has no effect on the existing disk version of the current design. The new current design name will be displayed in the window border and becomes the default name for`axlSaveDesign`.

name: axlRenameNet
summary: Renames a net. For the old object, may either give a string with the net name to be renamed, or`dbid` of an object on that net. Fails if the new net name already exists in the database.

name: axlRenameRefdes
summary: Renames a refdes. For either argument, may use a refdes name or a component instance.

name: axlReplacePadstack
summary: Replaces the padstack on a pin or via (or a list of them). Will not print any error messages unless you have argument errors.

name: axlReportList
summary: Lists all the SKILL reports registered to the Allegro PCB Editor report interface. Even if you do not register any reports, Allegro PCB Editor registers default reports written in SKILL.

name: axlReportRegister
summary: Allows registration of user reports using the Allegro PCB Editor report dialog box. You provide a report name, title, and a report-generating callback function. Callback function format is:`g_reportCallback(t_outfile).`The callback should, if it generates the report, should return a `t` from the function. If it does not generate a report return a `nil` .

name: axlReratNet
summary: Rerats a net. Normally this is not required since Allegro PCB Editor automatically updates ratsnesting as required.

name: axlRunBatchDBProgram
summary: Spawns batch jobs that require an open database via an abstract model. When the job completes, it prints a message and optionally reloads (`?reloadDB`) the database if successful. If the database is saved from the current active database, it uses a temporary name to avoid overwriting the database on disk.

name: axlSaveDesign
summary: Saves the design with the name specified (`t_design`). If `t_design` is not specified, the current design name is used. If `t_design` is provided but the value is `nil`, you are prompted for the name. If `t_option` is `"nocheck"`, the database "quick check" is not provided. Use this option only when there is a very compelling reason.

name: axlSaveEnable
summary: This queries or sets the design to save design. When`t,` the *File - Save design* menu command is enabled. If `nil,` it is disabled.

name: axlSchedule
summary: Gets net schedule. When`g_userSchedule` is`t,`this fetches the `a` user schedule or a partial user schedule from a net. Returns nil if the net is completely algorithm scheduled. Using`t` is recommended. When `g_userSchedule` is nil, returns the schedule of the complete net even if the net is completely algorithm scheduled.

name: axlScheduleNet
summary: This applies a user schedule or a partial user schedule to a net. Format of`t_schedule` is a string in the $SCHEDULE netin (3rd party) format.

name: axlSegDelayAndZ0
summary: Returns the delay and impedance of a cline segment. Returns`nil` if a segment isn't a cline segment. Normally, delay is in nanoseconds and impedance is in ohms.

name: axlSelect
summary: General tool for AXL programs to solicit interactive object selections from the user.`axlSelect` automatically sets up the pop-up to provide any of the possible Allegro PCB Editor selection methods:

name: axlSelectByName
summary: Selects database objects by name.

name: axlSelectByProperty
summary: Selects the`dbid` set of a particular Allegro PCB Editor database object with the indicated property.

name: axlSetActiveLayer
summary: Sets the active class and subclass of the design.

name: axlSetAlias
summary: You can set the Allegro PCB Editor environment alias with the name given by the string`t_alias` to the value `g_value` using the `axlSetAlias` function. `g_value` can be a string, int, t, or nil. Returns the string assigned to the alias or `nil` if the alias cannot be set in Allegro PCB Editor.

name: axlSetAllProfilesVisible
summary: Turns all wire profiles in the design on or off.

name: axlSetAttachment
summary: Modifies an existing Allegro PCB Editor database attachment with the data contained in the given AXL attachment id. Original attachment object must be obtained from the`axlCreateAttachment`, `axlGetAttachment`, or `axlGetAllAttachments` function. The attachment revision number and the attachment data may both be modified.

name: axlSetBondWireProfile
summary: This command allows you to change the bond wire profile on one or more bond wires in the design. The bond wire profile definition must already exist in the design.

name: axlSetDefaultDieInformation
summary: Sets the default die information for a component.

name: axlSetDieData
summary: Sets the given data for the given die.

name: axlSetDieStackData
summary: This function sets the given data for the specified die.

name: axlSetDieType
summary: This function sets the attachment type for a die component to one of the available types. Currently, the supported attachment types are:

name: axlSetDynamicsMirror
summary: Sets the Dynamics mirroring.

name: axlSetDynamicsRotation
summary: Sets the Dynamics rotation. If angle is nil then returns current rotation.

name: axlSetFindFilter
summary: Sets up both the object types to be displayed in the Find Filter, and which types among those are set to*on* in the **Find Filter**.

name: axlSetFunckey
summary: Works similar to`axlSetAlias` except allows alpha-number keys to work like function keys (no Enter key required). See `axlSetAlias` for complete documentation.

name: axlSetIposerData
summary: Sets the given data for the given iposer.

name: axlSetLineLock
summary: Sets one or more of the line lock parameters. The parameters are the same as those accessible in the*Line Lock* section of the Allegro PCB Editor Status form.

name: axlSetParam
summary: This allows applications to modify certain aspects of Allegro parameters. After a parameter has been retrieved, attributes of it can be changed locally. Those changes can then be put back into the database using`axlSetParam`.

name: axlSetPlaneType
summary: This changes the photoplot type of a conductor or plane type layer between positive or negative artwork. Changing a layer already containing data will require re-voiding existing shapes and updating DRC.

name: axlSetRotateIncrement
summary: Sets the dynamic rotate angle increment in degrees (`f_angular`) or radians (`f_radial`). Sets the rotate increment for rotation of objects in the dynamic buffer.

name: axlSetSpacerData
summary: This function sets the given data for the given spacer.

name: axlSetSymbolType
summary: Sets the Allegro PCB Editor symbol type. Has some minor effect on the commands available and the edit checks performed when the symbol is "compiled" (axlCompileSymbol).

name: axlSetVariable
summary: Sets the Allegro PCB Editor environment variable with name given by the string`t_variable` to the value `g_value`. `g_value` can be a string, int, `t`, or `nil`. Returns the string assigned to the variable or `nil` if the variable cannot be set in Allegro PCB Editor.

name: axlSetVariableFile
summary: Sets and saves to file Allegro environment variable. This operates the same asaxlSetVariable except it also saves the setting to the user's local environment file.

name: axlSetWireProfileColor
summary: This function will set the color of a wire profile to the given value.

name: axlShapeAutoVoid
summary: Autovoids a static shape using current static shape parameters to control voiding except where options provide an override. Voiding dynamic shapes or dynamically-generated shapes is not supported.

name: axlShapeChangeDynamicType
summary: Swaps a connectivity shape from static to dynamic or the reverse. This offers the same functionality as the Allegro PCB Editor command`shape change type`.

name: axlShapeDeleteVoids
summary: Lets you delete voids in a shape. Supports the following three forms of arguments:

name: axlShapeDynamicUpdate
summary: Updates a dynamic shape, or if`nil`, all dynamic shapes are updated. This ignores the current dynamic shape mode setting of the design.

name: axlShapeMerge
summary: This merges shapes. Shapes must be overlapped without the fixed property to merge. All merging shapes (`lo_shapes`) must overlap the primary shape (`o_shapeId`).

name: axlShapeRaisePriority
summary: Raises the voiding priority of a dynamic shape (`o_shapeId`) to the highest on the chosen layer. If this shape overlaps other dynamic shapes on the layer, the other shapes void away from this shape.

name: axlShell
summary: Issues the Allegro PCB Editor command string`t_commands` to the connected editor. You can chain commands. This call is synchronous.

name: axlShellPost
summary: This works similar to`axlShell` except it first requires a return from the Skill interpreter before executing the command(s). It should only be used in the special circumstance where you want to do some processing in Skill, execute an Allegro PCB Editor interactive command and have that command be left active for the user. If more the one command is embedded in post command then subsequent commands should be prefixed with an underscore to inhibit scripting. For example:

name: axlShoveItems
summary: Takes a list of`dbids` and shoves them according to the parameters set using `axlShoveSetParams`.

name: axlShoveSetParams
summary: Sets the parameters used for shoving by the`axlShoveItems`. If you do not provide all values, the indicated default is used.

name: axlShowObject
summary: Displays the object data for each`dbid` in `lud_dbid` in a *Show Element* window. Does the same function as the interactive command `list element.``lud_dbid` can be either a single `dbid` or a list of `dbids`.

name: axlShowObjectToFile
summary: Creates a temporary file with show element information on`dbids` specified in `lo_dbid`.

name: axlSingleSelectBox
summary: Clears the select set, finds all figures inside the rectangle`l_bBox` according to the Find Filter, and adds the selected figure `dbids` in single mode to the select set.

name: axlSingleSelectName
summary: Finds figures by their names. Clears the current contents of the select set and adds named figure`dbids` to the select set in single mode using the arguments as described below. The function selects any figures completely, regardless of the selection mode. If the function selects a figure already partially selected, the figure becomes fully selected.

name: axlSingleSelectObject
summary: Clears contents of the select set and adds the`dbids` in `lo_dbid` to the select set in single mode. `lo_dbid` is either a single `dbid` or a list of `dbids`. Selects figures completely regardless of the selection mode. If the `dbid` of any part of a figure is in `lo_dbid`, the function adds the entire figure.

name: axlSingleSelectPoint
summary: Clears the select set, finds a figure at`l_point` according to the Find Filter, and puts the selected figure `dbid` in the select set. If `l_point` is `nil`, the function requests a single pick from the user.

name: axlSleep
summary: Sleeps specified time.

name: axlSmoothDesign
summary: Smooths the entire design. For good results on complicated designs, multiple passes are necessary. Since changes in one pass may open space that can be used in the next pass. Suggest 3 is a typical number although very complex designs can benefit from a higher number of passes. But the more passes the longer it will take.

name: axlSmoothItems
summary: Takes a list of dbids representing clines and/or cline segments and smooths them according to the parameters set using theaxlSmoothSetParams() function.

name: axlSmoothSetParams
summary: Sets the parameters used for smoothing the routes. All parameters must be supplied but a nil as a parameter option will leave the existing setting.

name: axlSnapToObject
summary: Supports snapping to a logic object's connect point. A logic object is a:

name: axlSort
summary: Sorts contents of a given input file and places results in the output file. No warning is given if the output file overwrites an existing file - any checking must be done by the caller of this function.

name: axlSpreadsheetClose
summary: Releases the spreadsheet document in memory. All information is freed. This function should be called whenever you have completed working with the active spreadsheet document.

name: axlSpreadsheetDefineCell
summary: Completely defines a single cell in the active worksheet. This function is more efficient than callingaxlSpreadsheetSetCell with multiple axlSpreadsheetSetCellProp calls afterwards.

name: axlSpreadsheetDoc
summary: The axlSpreadsheet family of functions allow you to read and write Microsoft's open XML-based spreadsheet format from within skill. You can create a spreadsheet from data within your active Allegro tool, or you can read a spreadsheet and extract information from it to update your database.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetCell
summary: Retrieves the data from the specified cell.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetRGBColorString
summary: Given red, green, and blue color values, return an RGB string for use in spreadsheet style definitions in format required for Microsoft open spreadsheet format.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetRGBForNamedColor
summary: Spreadsheets have a small set of known, pre-defined color values. To retrieve the RGB value for a specific named color, pass that color name to this function.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetStyles
summary: Retrieves a list of all the styles defined for the active spreadsheet. If no worksheets currently exist,`nil` is returned.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetWorksheetSize
summary: Return the "size" of the current worksheet, in terms of the highest row and column which have data.

name: axlSpreadsheetGetWorksheets
summary: Retrieves a list of all the worksheets defined in the active spreadsheet. If no worksheets currently exists,`nil` is returned.

name: axlSpreadsheetInit
summary: Initializes an empty spreadsheet document to begin filling it with worksheets, styles, and cell data. A new spreadsheet, when first initialized, does not include any of this information. It is completely empty.

name: axlSpreadsheetRead
summary: Read a spreadsheet file on disk into memory for data access and manipulation. File is expected to be in Microsoft XML open spreadsheet format. For text-delimited files, useaxlSpreadsheetReadDelimited.

name: axlSpreadsheetReadDelimited
summary: Read a text file on disk into memory for data access and manipulation as a spreadsheet. File is expected to be a delimited text file, with cell delimiters as specified in the`t_delimiter` argument. For XML spreadsheets, use axlSpreadsheetRead.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetCell
summary: Make the active row/column of the current worksheet active.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetCellProp
summary: Sets a property on the active cell in the spreadsheet.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetColumnProp
summary: Sets a property for the given column of the active worksheet.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetDocProp
summary: Sets a property on the document (spreadsheet) itself.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetRowProp
summary: Sets a property for the given row of the active worksheet.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetStyle
summary: Defines or activates the specified style in the active spreadsheet. Styles may be referenced in any worksheet of the spreadsheet. You do not need to redefine the style for each new worksheet you create.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetStyleBorder
summary: Sets the cell border properties for a active style definition.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetStyleParent
summary: Sets the active style's parent. Style will inherit default properties from its parent style, therefore only changes need to be specified in the child style. Parent must already be defined for spreadsheet.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetStyleProp
summary: Sets a specific style property in the active style definition.

name: axlSpreadsheetSetWorksheet
summary: Makes the specified worksheet the active one for future cell references. If the worksheet does not exist, it is created as the new last worksheet in the document.

name: axlSpreadsheetWrite
summary: Write the spreadsheet in memory to file on disk. File will be written compliant with Microsoft's open spreadsheet XML format.

name: axlStrcmpAlpNum
summary: Provides an alpha-numeric sort similar to`alphalessp` with one important distinction. If both strings end in the number, the number portion is separated and the two stripped strings are first compared. If they are equal, then the number sections are compared as numbers, rather than strings.

name: axlStringCSVParse
summary: Parses a comma delimited line (typical from Excel). This differs from the Skill prehistorian function in several areas which make it compatible with Excel csv file format:

name: axlStringRemoveSpaces
summary: This will strip leading or trailing whitespace from a string (standard C`ilspace()` macro). Has two modes:

name: axlSubSelectAll
summary: Finds all figures in the database that pass the current Find Filter and deletes their`dbids` from the select set. Use `axlSubSelectAll` to subtract all of a given type of figure from a larger set of selected objects.

name: axlSubSelectBox
summary: Finds one or more figures inside the rectangle`l_bBox` according to the Find Filter, and deletes their `dbids` from the select set in *cumulated* mode. Deletes those `dbids` while leaving any others currently in the select set.

name: axlSubSelectName
summary: Removes`dbids` of the named figure from the select set using the arguments described. Removes figures completely regardless of the selection mode. If the function finds a figure already partially selected, it removes all of its `dbids` from the select set.

name: axlSubSelectObject
summary: Removes the`dbids` in `lo_dbid` from the select set in cumulated mode. `lo_dbid` is either a single `dbid` or a list of `dbids`. Removes figures completely regardless of the selection mode.

name: axlSubSelectPoint
summary: Finds a figure at`l_point` according to the Find Filter and deletes its `dbid` from the select set in cumulated mode. That is, it deletes that `dbid` while leaving any others currently in the select set. If `l_point` is `nil`, requests a single pick from the user.

name: axlSubclassFormPopup
summary: Builds a form pop-up for a given Allegro PCB Editor class for a given field of`r_form` using the `axlSubclassFormPopup` function. This function is a combination of `axlGetParam` and `axlFormBuildPopup` with color swatching.

name: axlSubclassRoute
summary: Lists subclasses that make up class ETCH.

name: axlSubclasses
summary: Lists subclasses that make up a class. This function is supported in both, APD and Allegro name space. The field and value options provide additional filtering based upon the characteristics of the layer.

name: axlSymbolAttach
summary: Attaches an object or list of objects to symbol instance. For etch objects, provides the ability to associate pin escapes with a symbol.

name: axlSymbolDetach
summary: Remove an object from a symbol instance. This function unlinks objects from the given symbol instance.

name: axlTechnologyType
summary: Returns the type of design technology in use.

name: axlTempDirectory
summary: Returns the temporary directory for the current platform.

name: axlTempFile
summary: Returns a unique temp file name. The temp file should be removed, even if not used, by`axlTempFileRemove`.

name: axlTempFileRemove
summary: Deletes the temporary file and removes the temporary name from the pool. It is important to call this function once you are finished with a temporary filename.

name: axlTestPoint
summary: Sets or clears a pin and/or via's test point status. Abides by the rules of the testprep parameter form in its ability to add a test point (see possible errors, below). If testprep rules prevent adding a test point, an error symbol is returned. If the command fails for other reasons,`nil` is returned. On success, a `t` is returned.

name: axlText2Lines
summary: This vectorizes a text dbid into a list of lists of`r_path` objects.

name: axlTextOrientationCopy
summary: This is a convenience function that updates a TextOrientation defstruct based upon a text dbid. This is typically used with axlDBCreateText oraxlDBChangeText.

name: axlTransformObject
summary: Moves, rotates, and/or spins one object or a list of objects. Each Allegro PCB Editor database object has a legal set of transforms (seeTable 5-1). If the object does not accept a transform, then that transform is silently ignored.

name: axlTriggerClear
summary: Removes a registered callback trigger. You pass the same arguments you passed as you registered the trigger.

name: axlTriggerPrint
summary: Debug function that prints what is registered for triggers.

name: axlTriggerSet
summary: Allows an application to register interest in events that occur in Allegro PCB Editor. When called with both arguments as`nil`, returns a list of supported triggers.

name: axlUICmdPopupSet
summary: Sets up a popup menu with all menu items required throughout the execution of the command. Call during the command's initialization process. Use of this procedure modifies the behavior of`axlUIPopupSet`so that it makes unavailable all popup items not in the defined popup.

name: axlUIColorDialog
summary: Invokes standard color selection dialog box. You must provide a parent window, Allegro PCB Editor defaults to the main window of the application. The`l_rgb` is a red, green, or blue palette list. Each item is an integer between the values of `0` and `255`. `0` indicates color is off, and a value of `255` indicates color is completely on. For example, `255 255 255` indicates white.

name: axlUIConfirm
summary: Displays the string`t_message` in a confirmer window.

name: axlUIConfirmEx
summary: Displays the string`t_message` in a confirmer window with an optional check box to never show the box again.

name: axlUIControl
summary: Inquire about graphics canvas. Inquires and sets the value of graphics. If setting a value, the return is the old value of the control.

name: axlUIDataBrowse
summary: Analyzes all objects requested by the caller function, passing each through the caller's callback function. Then puts the objects in a single-selection list.

name: axlUIEditFile
summary: Allows the user to edit a file in an OS independent manner (works under both UNIX and Windows.)

name: axlUIGetUserData
summary: Gets the current user data structure from Allegro PCB Editor. The user data structure stores basic information about the state of the user interface. By default it contains the properties:

name: axlUIMenuChange
summary: This changes one or more parameters of an existing menu item.

name: axlUIMenuDebug
summary: A debug function for axl Menu Trigger. This helps debug issues withaxlUIMenuRegister.

name: axlUIMenuDelete
summary: This deletes a single menu item or submenu based upon what is the current find menu item.

name: axlUIMenuDump
summary: Dumps the current menu of the main window to the`t_menuFile`file. Adds default menu file name extension if `t_menuFile` has none.

name: axlUIMenuFind
summary: Finds a menu item by location or a command. The location (`x_location`) is 0 based. The 0 location is the left or top most menu item. (Typically, this is the *File* menu item on the menu bar). A negative number may be used to specify a menu counting from the right side with a -1 indicating the menu furthest to the left or bottom.

name: axlUIMenuInsert
summary: Inserts menu items to an existing menu. Several modes are supported:

name: axlUIMenuLoad
summary: Loads the main window menu from the file`t_menuFile`. Adds a default menu file name extension if `t_menuFile` has none. The `MENUPATH` environment variable is used to locate the file if `t_menuFile` does not include the entire path from the root drive.

name: axlUIMenuRegister
summary: This allows you to register menu items to be loaded when Allegro loads a new menu. It is a combination ofaxlUIMenuFind and axlUIMenuInsert.

name: axlUIMultipleChoice
summary: Displays a dialog box containing a question with a set of two or more answers in a list. You must choose one of the answers to continue. Returns the chosen answer.

name: axlUIPopupDefine
summary: Creates a pop-up from the name value pair list`ts_pairs`. If `r_popup` already exists, it appends the name value pairs at the end of the existing pairs in `r_popup`. Use the returned `r_popup` id as the argument to `axlUIPopupSet` to make it the active pop-up.

name: axlUIPopupSet
summary: Sets the active pop-up in Allegro PCB Editor. If`r_popup` is `nil`, unsets the currently active pop-up.

name: axlUIPrompt
summary: Displays the string`t_message` in a form. The user must type a response into the field. Displays the argument `t_default` in brackets to the left of the field. The user presses the *Return* key or clicks the *OK*button in the window to accept the value of `t_default` as the function return value. If the user selects the *Cancel* button, the function returns `nil`.

name: axlUIViewFileCreate
summary: Opens a file view window to display a file (`t_file`), it is an error for file not to exist. Window should be given a title (t_title).

name: axlUIViewFileReuse
summary: Reuses the view window to display a file (t_file). Error is thrown if the file does not exist. Window is given a title (t_title).

name: axlUIViewFileScrollTo
summary: Scrolls to a specified line in the file viewer. A value of`-1` goes to the end of the viewer.

name: axlUIWBeep
summary: Sends an alert to the user, usually a beep.

name: axlUIWBlock
summary: * ***This function is not compatible with the g_nonBlock = nil option to axlFormCreate. If using this function with axlFormCreate you must set a callback on the g_formAction.***

name: axlUIWClose
summary: Closes a window, if it is open.

name: axlUIWCloseAll
summary: This closes all temporary windows (dialogs and text view windows). A temporary window is a dialog that closes if you open another design (e.g. brd). Via Skill this window attribute is set by the axlUIWPerm API. The constraint manager is currently considered a permanent window but this may change in future releases. A blocking window (e.g. File Browser dialogs) cannot be closed via this call.

name: axlUIWDisableQuit
summary: Disables the system menu*Quit* option so the user cannot choose it to close the window.

name: axlUIWExpose
summary: Opens and redisplays a hidden or iconified window, bringing it to the front of all other current windows on the display. If`nil`, the main window is displayed.

name: axlUIWExposeByName
summary: Finds a window by name and exposes it (raises it to the top of the window stack and restores it to a window state it if it is an icon).

name: axlUIWHelpRegister
summary: This registers a help document for a user written skill command or form (dialog). This is typically used in conjunction with axlCmdRegister. You should make this call at the time you do a axlCmdRegister instead of waiting until the skill code associated with the command executes.

name: axlUIWIconify
summary: This command either creates an icon for a window or open a window from an icon.This is different fromaxlUIWExpose, which also opens a window from an icon but exposes hidden windows and permits raising a window to the top of the stack. Note all sub-windows also open or closed to an icon. So, if you make the main Allegro PCB Editor window an icon, all of its child windows are also closed.`t_window` name may change from release to release although this is not normal. `nil` may be used for the main window. Currently, Constraint Manager interface is not supported by this skill command.

name: axlUIWIsIconic
summary: Is the window in an icon state.`nil` may be used for the main window. `t_window` name may change from release to release although this is not normal. Constraint Manager is not yet supported by this skill command.

name: axlUIWIsWindow
summary: Returns`t` if named window is open. `t_window` name may change from release to release although this is not normal.

name: axlUIWMove
summary: Moves a window. New location (`l_xy`) which is upper left corner, is specified in pixels.

name: axlUIWPerm
summary: Normally forms and other windows close automatically when another database opens. This function allows that default behavior to be overridden.

name: axlUIWPrint
summary: Prints a message to a window other than the main window. If`r_window` does not have a message line, the message goes to the main window. This function does not buffer messages, but displays them immediately. If the message string does not start with a message class (for example \e), it is treated as a text (\t) message. (See axlMsgPut) If `nil`, displays the main window.

name: axlUIWRedraw
summary: Redraws indicated window. If window ID is`nil` redraws the main window.

name: axlUIWSetHelpTag
summary: This has been mostly replaced byaxlUIWHelpRegister that works for commands and forms.

name: axlUIWSetParent
summary: Sets the parent of a window. When a window is created, its parent is the main window of the application, which is sufficient for most implementations. To run blocking mode on a form launched from another form, set the child form's parent window to be the launched form.

name: axlUIWShow
summary: Shows or hides a window depending on the option passed. If the window id passed is`nil`, the function applies to the main window.

name: axlUIWSize
summary: Returns outer size of a window. Size is in pixels. x and y coordinates are upper left corner of window.

name: axlUIWTimerAdd
summary: Adds or removes a callback for an interval timer.

name: axlUIWTimerRemove
summary: Removes a timer added by`axlUIWTimerAdd`.

name: axlUIWUpdate
summary: Forces an update of a window. If you made several changes to a window and are not planning on going back to the main loop or doing a SKILL call that requires user interaction, use this call to update a window. You could use this, for example, if you are doing time-consuming processing without giving back the control to the UI message pump.

name: axlUIYesNo
summary: Provides a dialog box displaying the message`t_message`. Returns `t` if you choose *Yes* and `nil` for *No*.

name: axlUIYesNoCancel
summary: Displays a blocking*Yes*`/`*No*`/`*Cancel* dialog box with the prompt message provided.

name: axlUnfixAll
summary: This is a convenience API.

name: axlUnsetVariable
summary: Unsets the Allegro PCB Editor environment variable with the name given by the string`t_variable`. The value of the named variable becomes `nil`.

name: axlUnsetVariableFile
summary: Unsets the value of specified Allegro environment variable. Works the same asaxlUnsetVariable plus it also updates the local environment file of the user with the change.

name: axlVersion
summary: Returns Allegro PCB Editor or OS dependent data.

name: axlVersionIdGet
summary: Returns an id stamp based upon computer time.

name: axlVersionIdPrint
summary: Prints version_id.

name: axlViaZLength
summary: Returns the via length from layer1 to layer2. The layer names can either be given as the ETCH subclass name (TOP) or given as the formal skill layer name ("ETCH/TOP").

name: axlVisibleDesign
summary: Makes entire design visible or invisible. This command does not visually change the display, since it can also be used in conjunction with the`axlSelect` command family to provide additional filtering of the database objects. If you wish to visually update the display, call `axlUIWUpdate(nil)` after changing the visibility.

name: axlVisibleGet
summary: Returns the visibility of the entire design - which layers are visible/invisible.

name: axlVisibleLayer
summary: Sets a given layer to visible or invisible. If given only a class name, sets the entire layer to visible or invisible. If you want to update the display, call`axlVisibleUpdate` when finished with your layer visibility updates.

name: axlVisibleSet
summary: Sets the visibility of the entire design.

name: axlVisibleUpdate
summary: The`axlVisible` family and its base building block permit changing layer color and visibility.

name: axlWFMAnyExported
summary: Reports if there are any exported partitions.

name: axlWidth2Impedance
summary: Converts the given line width on a specified layer to an impedance. This uses the field solver to compute the impedance

name: axlWindowBoxGet
summary: Returns the bounding box of the Allegro PCB Editor window currently visible to the user, in design units.

name: axlWindowBoxSet
summary: Sets Allegro PCB Editor display to given bBox. Adjusts it according to the aspect ratio and returns the adjusted bBox.

name: axlWindowFit
summary: Zooms in to (or out of) a design fitting it fully on the window. For the Allegro PCB Editor in layout mode, performs a fit on the outline. For the Allegro PCB Editor symbol mode, performs a fit such that all visible objects occupy maximum window area. Returns the bounding box of the window after the fit has been performed.

name: axlWriteDeviceFile
summary: Given a component definition, writes out a third party device file. Writes to the directory specified, or if no directory or`nil` is given, writes to the current directory.

name: axlWritePackageFile
summary: Given a symbol definition, writes out symbol`.dra`, `.psm` and associated padstack files. Works like `dump_libraries` on a single symbol definition.

name: axlXSectionCopy
summary: This copies dbid xsection to an xsection Skill defstruct.It can be used to duplicate the charactistics of an existing xsection layer to a new layer for use with axlXSectionCreate. Alternatively, it can be used to modify an existing layer via axlXSectionSet, although axlXSectionModify might be a better fit for changing a layer.

name: axlXSectionCreate
summary: Creates a new cross section entry.

name: axlXSectionDelete
summary: Deletes a cross section layer. If layer is associated with an ETCH layer, the associated layer is also deleted. Associated ETCH layers must not have objects. SeeaxlLayerDelete for other reasons for failure.

name: axlXSectionGet
summary: Returns data about the cross-section entry for a design.

name: axlXSectionLayerFunctions
summary: Return list of supported layer function types.Layer functions are a super set of layer types.

name: axlXSectionLayerTypes
summary: Return list of supported layer types. This is used withlayerType attribute when adding or modifing xsection layers.

name: axlXSectionModify
summary: This is a wrapper for`make_axlXSection()` function to createa new defstruct. For certain fields (e.g. boolean and some string fields) a `'none` symbol is used to indicate that the field should not be changed, other fields can use the default `nil` symbol.

name: axlXSectionSet
summary: Modifies an existing cross section entry. UseaxlXSectionModify to create a xsection defstruct with the attributes you wish to modify.

name: axlZoomBbox
summary: x_window: window id or nil to currently active window. nil is the activewindow and 0 is the primary canvas. Allegro currently onlysupports one additional canvas so the value 1 indicates thatcanvas.

name: axlZoomCenter
summary: Zoom centers on the provided coordinate. It may adjust the point if centering results in the display bounding extents are outside thedesign extents.

name: axlZoomControl
summary: Manages the multi-canvas feature. Requires OpenGL to be enabled.Id 0 is the main Allegro canvas.

name: axlZoomFit
summary: Zoom fits the window. Depending upon the design type fit is define as:

name: axlZoomInOut
summary: Zooms window in or out by provided factor around optional coordinate.

name: axlZoomPoints
summary: Zoom windows by points. The zoom maintains a 1:1 aspect ratio,the coordinates provided will be fitted into the active window size.

name: axlZoomToDbid
summary: Processes a list of`dbids` and centers and zooms the display around them. Zoom is done so objects extents fill about 20% of the display. You should highlight the objects.

name: axlZoomWorld
summary: Zoom world a drawing window

name: axlcreate
summary: This interface is obsolete. It is kept to support existing SKILL code.

name: axldo
summary: A do function, modeled after the CL (Common Lisp) do.
